dharmo viśvasya jagataḥ pratiṣṭhā
prājñapāṭhaśālā maṇḍala granthamālā
mīmāṃsākoṣaḥ
prathamo bhāgaḥ
saṃpādakaḥ kebalānandasarasvatī
mārgaśīrṣaḥ śuklaḥ 4 śukravāraḥ śakaḥ 1874.
prakāśakasya nivedanam
asmadgurucaraṇaiḥ śrīmatkevalānandasarasvatībhiḥ pūrvamīmāṃsākośaḥ sāṅgaḥ sapariśiṣṭo vyaraci |
tasya svarūpaṃ savistaraṃ taiḥ svayameva prastāve viśadīkṛtam |
ayaṃ kośaḥ ṣaṭsu bhāgeṣu vibhajya prakāśayitavyo'sti |
asya saṃpādanaṃ sarvathā śrīpūjyapādakevalānandasvāmibhireva sudīrghakālaṃ jaiminīyatantrasya tatsaṃgatānāṃ bhāṣya- vārtikādiṭikānāmanveṣāṃ ca mīmāṃsānibandhānāṃ, kalpasūtrāṇāṃ, vedacatuṣṭayasya ca ālodanaṃ kṛtvā nirvartitamasti |
atra tvayaṃ viśeṣo yat aitihāsikasaraṇimanusṛtya vyākhyākrama upanyasto'sti |
asya kośasyānte pariśiṣṭatrayamantarbhāvitamasti, yatra bhāṣyavārtikādiṣudṛṣṭvānāṃ śrutivākyānāṃ mūlasthalanirdeśapūrvakaṃ viṣamasthalaṭippaṇīsahitā akārādivarṇānukrameṇa sūcī, yājñikapadārthavivecanakośaḥ, darśapūrṇamāsāgniṣṭomādiprakṛti- yāgaprayogāśca saṃgṛhyante |
bahuvittavyayāsādhyamidaṃ prakāśanakarma |
ye khalu vaidikavidyāpraṇayinaḥ udāradhiyastaitra svadhanavyayakaraṇenānupamaḥ puṇyasaṃdohaḥ samadhigantavya iti savinayaṃ nivedayāmaḥ |
muṃbaīrājyasya śikṣāvibhāgena daśa sahasrāṇi rūpyakāṇi dattvā asya prakāśanavyayasya bhāro laghukṛta iti tasya śataśo dhanyavādān vitarāmaḥ |
kiṃca vartakopākhyaiḥ mahādevatanūjaiḥ keśavanāmadheyaiḥ pañca sahasrāṇi rūpyakāṇi prakāśanavyayārthaṃ dattvā paramaudāryaṃ prakaṭīkṛtamiti te nitarāṃ praśaṃsārhamanti |
puṇyapattanavidyāpīṭhana prathamabhāgamudraṇārthaṃ rūpyakāṇāṃ sahasraṃ, muṃbaīvidyāpīṭhana ca pañca śatāni rūpyakāṇi dattvā prakāśanakāryamupakṛtamiti tayorvidyāpīṭhayorugrahaṃ nitarāmabhinandāmaḥ |
mārgaśīrṣaḥ śuklaḥ 4, } śakaḥ 1874. }
lakṣmaṇaśāstrī jośī, tarkatīrthaḥ adhyakṣaḥ prājñapāṭhaśālāṇḍalasya mukhyasaṃpādakaśca dharmakośasya

oṃ namo gurubhyaḥ |
nirmadhya nigamasindhūn vividhanyāyābhidhānamanthanaiḥ |
dharmasudhāmuddharate bhūyo munaye namo'stu jaiminaye ||
prastāvaḥ
mīmāṃsā prācīnaiva--
mīmāṃsā kila bahuḥ kālāt prāgeva yājñikānuṣṭhāneṣu pravarttate śrūyate |
aitareya- brāhmaṇe tāvat agniṣomagatadīkṣaṇīyeṣṭau agnāviṣṇudevatāka ekādaśakapālaḥ puroḍāśa uktaḥ |
tasya agniśca viṣṇuraśceti dvau devau |
tatraiyamāśaṅkā kaiścit brahmavādibhirupnyastā ‘ tadāhuḥ, yadekādaśakapālaḥ puroḍāśaḥ, dvāvanāviṣṇū, kā enayostatra klṛptiḥ kā vibhaktiḥ ’ iti |
tatra anyairbrahmavādibhiḥ pratyuktaṃ, aṣṭākapālaḥ āgneyaḥ, trikapālo vaiṣṇavaḥ iti |
tatra āgneyasya katha- maṣṭākapālatvaniyamaḥ ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ ‘ aṣṭākṣarā vai gāyatrī, gāyatramagneśchandaḥ ’ iti yuktirudā- hṛtā |
ayamarthaḥ - agneḥ gāyatrīcchandasaśca prajāpatermukhāt samakālamutpannatvena saṃbadvatvāt, gāyatryāśca praticaraṇamaṣṭākṣaratvāt āgneyapuroḍāśasyāpi aṣṭākapālatvamiti |
atha vaiṣṇavasya kathaṃ trikapāla- tvamiti cet, tatrāha ‘ trirhīdaṃ viṣṇuryakramat ’ yasmāt viṣṇunā sarvaṃ viśvaṃ tribhiḥ pādaprakramai- rvyāptaṃ, tasmāt viśvavyāpakapādaprakramatritvasaṃbandhāt viṣṇoḥ puroḍāśasya trikapālatvaṃ yuktamiti ( aitrā. 1|1|6-7 ) |
tathā agniṣomapraṇayane adhvaryuṇā anuvacanapreṣe datte ‘ sāvitrīṃ deva prathamāya pitre iti sāvitrīmanvāha ’ iti vidhinā hotrā savitṛdevatākā ‘ sāvitrīṃ deva ’ ityādikā ṛk anuvaktavyā ityu- ktam |
tatraiyamāśaṅkā udbhāvitā ‘ tadāhuḥ yadagnīṣomābhyāṃ praṇayamānābhyāṃ anu vācyā āha atha kasmāt sāvitrīmanvāha ’ iti |
agniṣomapraṇayanārthaṃ agniṣomadevatākā ṛk anuvaktavyā, savitṛ- devatākā kathaṃ vidhīyate iti |
tatrottaramevamuktam - ‘ savitā vai prasavānāmīśe tasmāt sāvitrī- manvāha ’ iti |
sarvāṇi hi kāryāṇi savitṛsamaṃtayaiva bhavanti, nahi savitṛprakāśaṃ vinā padāt padampi calituṃ kaścit śaknoti |
tasmāt sarvāsāṃ kāryasamatīnāṃ savitā īśe īṣṭe |
tasmāt tatsaṃmatiprāptyarthaṃ praṇayanārambhe savitṛdevatākaiva ṛk anuvaktavyā iti |
anyānyapi anekānyu- dāharaṇāni śaṅkāsamādhānātmakamamīmāṃsāsūcakāni brāhmaṇagrantheṣu draṣṭavyāni |
atha aitareyāraṇyake (3|1|2) 'etaṃ hyeva bahvṛcā mahatyukthe mīmāṃsante, etamamnāya- dhyarvaḥ, etaṃ mahāvrate chandogāḥ' iti |
bahvṛcaḥ ṛcaḥ paṭhitvā yeṣāṃ te bahvṛcā ṛgvedinaḥ mahati ukthe śastrātmakatve etaṃ paramātmānameva mīmāṃsante vicārayanti |
adhvaryavaḥ yajurvedinaḥ agnau agnicayanagatamantreṣu paramātmānaṃ mīmāṃsante 'yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyaḥ' ityādiṣu |
chandogāḥ chandaḥsu gānakartāraḥ sāmavedinastu mahāvrate mahāvratagatamantreṣu paramātmānaṃ mīmāṃsante iti |
atra 'mīmāṃsante' iti sākṣānmīmāṃsāvācakapadameva prayuktam |
mīmāṃsā nāma saṃśayapūrvakādvicārāt jāyamāno nirṇayaḥ |
so'yamarthaḥ : taittirīya- brāhmaṇe uktaḥ (2|1|2) kadā cit palāya gacchantamibhamavaroddhuṃ prajāpatiḥ agre : pṛṣṭhataḥ adhāvat |
na ca ativegavantamabhimavaroddhuṃ prajāpatiraśaknot |
śrāntaśca prajāpatirdhamyanto'- bhūt |
tataḥ saḥ ca cidupaviśya svalalāṭāt svedajalamunmṛṣṭavān |
tacca jalaṃ ghṛtarūpeṇa prādurbhūta |
etasminnantare homakālaḥ prātaḥ |
ājyena ca homaḥ kartavyaḥ, tadānī- manyasya dravyasyābhāvāt |
tena tadā'yaṃ hotuṃ haste gṛhītavān prajāpatiḥ |
apavitra- svedajalajanyatvācca tasya ghṛtasya prajāpatiḥ saṃdehaṃ prāpnot |
taduktaṃ 'tad vyacikitsat |
juhvāni, mā hauṣamiti |
tadvicikitsāye janma |
ya evaṃ vidvān vicikitsati |
vasīya eva cetayate' iti |
asyāyamarthaḥ :- tat svedajanyaṃ ghṛtaṃ prati vi-acikitsat vicikitsāṃ saṃśayaṃ prāpat |
ko'sau saṃśayaḥ tamāha, kiṃ juhvāni anena ghṛtena kiṃ mayā homaḥ kartavyaḥ, athavā mā hauṣaṃ mayā homo na kartavyaḥ anena ghṛtena iti |
homayogyaṃ na vā ghṛtametat iti saṃśayaḥ |
tadetat vicikitsāye vicikitsāyāḥ janma |
so'yametādṛśaḥ saṃśayaḥ prajāpatau utpanna ityarthaḥ |
yaḥ kaścit vidvān evaṃ prajāpatitvat vicikitsati saṃśayaṃ prāpya vicārayati, saḥ vasīya eva śreṣṭhatamameva cetayate jānāti, nirṇayaṃ labhate |
evamatra saṃśayapūrvakāvicārajanyo nirṇayaḥ iti spaṣṭameva mīmāṃsāsvarūpa- muktam |
gavāmayanavikṛtirūpasya utsargiṇāmayanasya saṃbandhi kiṃ cidahaḥ parityājyaṃ, na vā iti vicāritaṃ (taisaṃ. 7|5|7) 'utsṛjya notsṛjyamiti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ, tadāhurutsṛ- jyaneveti, amāvāsyāyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ cotsṛjyamityāhuḥ' iti |
atrāpi 'mīmāṃsante' iti spaṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ |
bṛhadāraṇyakopaniṣadyapi (1|5|21) 'ayāto vratamīmāṃsā' ityārabhya adhyātmamindriyāṇāṃ adhidaivataṃ ca devatānāṃ asādhāraṇaṃ karma vicāritam |
chāndogye'pi (5|11|1) aupamanyavādyaḥ 'mahāśrotriyāḥ sametya mīmāṃsāṃ cakruḥ ko na ātmā, kiṃ brahmeti' iti mīmāṃsāśabdaḥ spaṣṭaḥ |
'mīmāṃsāñcakruḥ' ityetāvataḥ kriyāpadasya svīkore'pi na hāniḥ |
athāto hotrāṇāmeva mīmāṃsā (śāṃśrau. 18|14|34) |
atra hotranuṣṭhāna- vicārānantaraṃ hotrakāṇāmeva vicāro'vaśiṣṭaḥ iti vyākhyānaṃ ānartīyabhāṣye |
'ayāstamite āditye udakaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, na gṛhṇīyāt iti mīmāṃsante brahmavādinaḥ' (baudha. 1|6|11) ityatra pūrvottarapakṣaparigraheṇa vicāro mīmāṃsāpadārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ |
'śuceraśraddhānasya śraddhānasya cāśuceḥ |
mīmāṃsobhayaṃ devāḥ samamannamakalpa- yan ||
' (baudha. 1|10|5) ityatra govindasvāminā vivaraṇe 'mīmāṃsitvā vicārya' iti vyākhyā- tam |
tena vicārārthako mīmāṃsāśabdaḥ |
gautamadharmasūtre 'tatra prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt na kuryāt, iti mīmāṃsante' (19|14) iti saṃśayamupanyasya 'na kuryādityāhuḥ' (5) iti pūrvapakṣapratijñāmupamyasya 'nahi karma kṣīyate iti' (6) ityanena pūrvapakṣe yuktirupamyastā |
'kuryādityaparam' (7) iti siddhānta- pratijñāmukatvā 'punaḥstameneṣvā' (8) ityādibhiḥ sūtraiḥ tatsādhikāḥ śrutaya udāhṛtāḥ |
tena pūrvottarapakṣaparigraheṇa vicāro mīmāṃsāpadārthaḥ spaṣṭo bhavati |
'tatra prāyaścittaṃ kuryāt kuryāditi mīmāṃsante |
(vādha. 2|12) na kuryādityāhuḥ (3) |
nahi karma kṣīyate iti (4) |
kuryādityeva tasmācchrutinidarśanāt (5) |
' iti atrāpi mīmāṃsāpadasya viśiṣṭavicāraparatvaṃ spaṣṭam |
sarvathā'pi mānavātpattimārabhyaiva mīmāṃsāyā apyārambhaḥ |
nāpi mānavā eva mīmāṃ- sante paśupakṣyādayastiyryañco'pi bhakṣyamidamabhakṣyaṃ veti mīmāṃsitvaiva bhakṣayanti |
vanacaṭakādayaḥ pakṣiṇo'pi prasūtikāle prāpte sthānaṃ mīmāṃsitvā anukūla eva sthāne anukūlaracanaṃ kulāyaṃ nirmimate |
iti tiryyakṣvapi mīmāṃsā samasyeva |
seyaṃ mīmāṃsā yathāprajñaṃ vardhamānā bhūyasīmeva pariṇatiṃ kālena prāptā |
tatredaṃ paṇḍitabuddhiprakarṣārdhānaṃ vedavākyārthanirṇāyakaṃ vākyārthamīmāṃsāpravāhaniṣkarṣarūpaṃ jaiminīmīmāṃsādarśanaṃ 'athāto dharmajijñāsā' ityāramya 'yathā yājyāsaṃ preṣo yathā yājyā- saṃpraiṣaḥ' ityantaṃ ṣoḍaśādhyāyātmakam |
mīmāṃsākoṣāvaśyakatā— mātuḥ katipayairvaiḥ sthitaḥ padbhyāṃ riṅkamāṇo vā bālaḥ mātāpitrādibhiruccāritān śabdān śṛṇvan tatkṛtaśca kriyāḥ paśyan kiyatyā cit kālakalayā asya vākyasyāyamartha ityavagacchati |
evameva nānāvidhān śabdān śṛṇvan paśyaṃśca karmāṇi vākyavayavān padarūpān tadarthā- śrāpi bhedenākalayati |
evaṃ padāvayavānapi prakṛtipratyayarūpān āpātato'vagacchati |
evaṃ padānāṃ padārthānāṃ ca vācyavācakabhāvaṃ jānan svayamapi tathā vyavaharati |
aśikṣitā nirakṣarā hālikājā- vipāladayo'pi satraṃ vyavahāraṃ kurvanto dṛśyante |
so'yaṃ vyavahārāt śaktigraha ityucyate |
śravaṇa-
darśanarūpavyavahāreṇaiva lipyādijñānaṃ vinaiva padapadārthayoḥ vākyavākyārthayośca saṃbandho bodhyabodhaka- rūpo vyavahāreṇaiva jīvanaparyanto jñāyate ityarthaḥ |
tato'dhikajñānamicchaṃstu vyavahārāditarānupā- yānavalambya bhūyo jñānaṃ labhate |
padaśaktigrahopāyāśca prācīnairuktāḥ ' śaktigrahaṃ vyākaraṇopamāna- kośavākyād vyavahārataśca |
vākyasya śeṣād vivṛtervadanti sānnidhyataḥ siddhapadasya vṛddhāḥ ||
' vṛddhāḥ etebhya upāyebhyaḥ śaktigrahaṃ vadanti |
tatra aśikṣitasya vyavahāro mukhya upāyaḥ, itare ke cidyathāyathaṃ ke citu naiva bhavanti |
śikṣamāṇānāṃ ca prauṭānāṃ kośo vyākaraṇaṃ ca pradhānam |
suśikṣitānāṃ tu kośa evaṃ mūlyaḥ upāyaḥ : bhinnabhāṣājñānādau |
viśvamedinyādayaḥ kośāḥ prācīnāḥ śabdārthasaṃbandhajñānārthameva viracitāstadātve vidvadbhiḥ |
amaratrikāṇḍī tu sarvaiṣāmeva gīrvāṇavāṇī- saṃpannānāmuttamā |
ata eva 'raghuḥ laghuḥ (laghukomudī) amaraḥ' iti trayī vyutpattijñāne mātevopa- yujyate iti prasiddhiḥ |
tattadbhāṣājñānopakāriṇaśca uccāvacā nānāvidhāḥ kośāḥ kośakārai- rviracitāḥ |
jāgatikajñānārthaṃ ca jñānakośā api mahānto mahadbhiḥ prakaṭitāḥ |
bhūyān hi kośagranthānāmāmupakāraḥ |
yathā śabdārthakośā bhavanti, tathā tattacchāstrīyaviṣayakośā api atī- vopakārakā bhavanti |
ekaśāstrābhyāsasya itaraśāstraviṣayakośā yathā sahāyaka bhavanti, tathā svaśāstrīyaviṣayakośasyāpi bhūyānupakāraḥ |
ekasmin hi śāstre aneke granthā bhavanti, na caikena te sarve granthā abhyasituṃ śakyante, tadā ca abhyasanīyaśāstragataviṣayakośalābha- śvet tadā śramaṃ kalpāyaṇaṃ ca vinaiva iṣṭaviṣayāṃśajñānaṃ sahasaiva bhavitumarhati |
asmābhireva tāvat dharmaśāstraṃ, vedāntaṃ cābhyasyadbhiḥ mīmāṃsāviṣayakośaṃ vinā bhūyobhūyaḥ skhalanaṃ kaṣṭaṃ cānu- bhūtam |
tenaiva ca hetunā mīmāṃsākośanirmāṇabuddhirutpannā |
ata eva 1858 śakīyapauṣaśuddha- caturthīdine mīmāṃsākośaracanāṃ saṃkalpya ārambhaḥ kṛtaḥ |
ekadā kṛtasya kiyatścit lekhasya anyadā maibhava bhūyānupayogaḥ sambhūtaḥ |
vedopāṅgāni catvāri purāṇanyāyamīmāṃsāśāstrāṇi |
tatra purāṇāni brāhmādī- nyaṣṭādaśa tāvanyevopapurāṇāni ca rāmāyaṇamahābhāratasahitāni |
nyāyaḥ vaiśeṣiko gautamīyaḥ kāpilo laukikaśca |
dharmaśāstraṃ manvādyaiḥ smṛtayaḥ |
mīmāṃsā ca viṃśatyadhyāyātmikā pūrvottaratvena dvedhā vibhaktā ṣoḍaśalakṣaṇī caturlakṣaṇī ceti |
tatra mīmāṃsā vākyaśāstratvāt padaśāstravat pramāṇaśāstravacca sarvopakāriṇī |
sarvaṃ vāṅmayavyavahāraḥ uccāraṇarūpo lekharūpaśca vākyātmaka eva |
vākyārthasya uddeśyavidheyabhāvādivicāraṃ vinā na jñātuṃ śakyate |
vākyārthanirṇayaśca vinā mīmāṃsāṃ na sidhyati |
tataśca nirṇayādvākyārthajñānāya vedānusāriṇāṃ mīmāṃsaivopayujyate |
na kevalaṃ vedānusārimeva kiṃtu taditareṣāmapi śabdāntareṇa prakārāntareṇa vā vākyamīmāṃsāyaiva vākyārtha- nirṇayo bhavatīti na vivādaḥ |
yadyapi jaiminimomāṃsā dharmamīmāṃsā |
dharmaśca veda iti tattadadhi- karaṇeṣu vedavākyanyeva udāhya śrutiliṅgavākyādibhirupaskṛtya prāptāprāptavivekana uddeśyavidheya-
bhāvaṃ nirṇaya itaravākyāvirodhena vākyārthaṃ nirṇayati mīmāṃsā |
vedavākyārthanirṇayasādhakanyāyaira stutipurāṇetihāsakāvyanāṭakākhyānakāvyākhyānakāthāsaritsāgarādikaṃ sakalameva gīrvāṇavāṇīgataṃ vāṅmayaṃ lokabhāṣāmayaṃ cāpi nānāvidhaṃ vicāragocarīkartuṃ jñātuṃ nirṇayituṃ śakyateti nāścaryam |
mīmāṃsā nāma ca pūjitavicāraḥ |
'māna pūjāyāṃ' iti pūjārthakamānadhātoḥ 'mānavadhadān' ityādisūtreṇa san pratyayaḥ |

jijñāsāśabdasya ca jñānecchāvācakatve'pi lakṣaṇayā icchā- sādhyavicārārthakatā |

(na ca śabdamātraṃ devatā iti navama- daśamyorabhidhāsyate|
vā. pṛ. 417) navame 'apivā śabdapūrvatvāt yajñakarma pradhānaṃ syād guṇatve devatāśrutiḥ' iti sūtre (9|1|9) bhūtabhavyasamuccāraṇanyāyena devatāyāḥ yāgaṃ prati guṇatve abhihite 'nanu karmaṇo'pi īpsitādabhipretatvaṃ devatāyā gamyate' ityāśaṅkaya 'nāsyāḥ abhi- pretatāmapahunumahe|
taddhitaśabdena caturthyā vā saṃyuktasya devatārthasya vākyādabhipretatā gamyate' (bhā. pṛ. 1652) iti bhāṣyeṇa anarthakavarṇasamūhasya prātipadikatvābhāve taddhitacaturthīsaṃyogā- yogāt tatsaṃyogābhidhānena arthagrahaṇena (ca) śabdamātrasya devatātvaṃ nirastam|
daśame ca 'vidhiśabdasya mantratve bhāvaḥ syāt tena codanā' (10|4|123) ityatra āvahanādau yenakena cit paryāyeṇa devatā'bhidhānasiddheḥ vidhivagatyādiśabdādanādaraḥ iti pūrvapakṣayitvā 'āgneyo'ṣṭākapālaḥ' itividhighatena agniśabdena devatāyāḥ haviḥsaṃbandhavidhānāt mantrakāryaṃ devatoddeśe vidhigatatathaiva śabdasya uccāraṇaṃ kāryaṃ iti siddhāntite 'kā punarayaṃ devatā nāma' iti pṛṣṭvā indrādīnāṃ yusthānānāṃ, vede vā yatra 'agnidevatā, vāto devatā' ityādi- devatāśabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, sā devatā iti paramatadvayaṃ ahaḥśārdūladīnāṃ anupasaṃgrahāpatteḥ nirasya, svamatena 'sūktabhājo havirbhājaśca devatāḥ' (mā. pṛ. 1927) iti bhāṣyeṇa 'agnidaivatyaṃ sūktaṃ' 'agnidaivatyaṃ haviḥ' ityādiprayogān 'āhutibhājo vā anyā devatā anyāḥ stoma- bhājaśchadobhājaḥ' iti liṅgācca sūktastutyasya lyajyamānahaviruddeśyasya ca devatātvābhidhānāt arthasya stutyatvoddeśyatvāvagateḥ, 'mūrtānāṃ amūrtānāṃ cetanānāmacetanānāṃ ca śrutyā kaṃ cidarthaṃ prati tādarthyena saṃkalpanīyānāṃ devatātvaṃ bhaviṣyati' (bhā. pṛ. 1927) iti ca bhāṣyeṇa mūrtānāṃ cetanānāṃ devatātvābhidhānāt, 'yasya vācakaṃ śabdamuddiśya haviḥ smṛtvā vā haviḥ lyakṣyāmi iti saṃkalpaḥ kriyate sā (tatra devatā) bhavati' (bhā. pṛ. 1927) iti ca bhāṣyeṇa uccāraṇā- rthatvāt diśeḥ uccāryamāṇena śabdena 'prajāpatiṃ manasā yajeta' ityādividhau vā smaryamāṇena vācyasya devatātvābhidhānāt, 'nanu evaṃ sati sutarāṃ yenakena cit agneḥ śabdena nirdeśaḥ karaṇīyaḥ' iti cāśaṅkaya 'bhavedetadevaṃ, yadi agniśabdaḥ arthapratyayāyanā- rthamuccāryeta, artho'pi haviḥsaṃbandhārthaṃ pratyāyyeta' ityupakramya (bhā. pṛ. 1927) 'devatāyāśca yajñasādhanabhāve na rūpeṇa bhavati|
kena tarhi? saṃbandhanā śabdena' ityādinā

1|1|5 pṛ. 25 bhāṣyamāha- “ vṛttikārastu anyayemaṃ granthaṃ varṇayāṃcakāra ' tasya nimittapariccheḥ ' ityeva- mādim |

tena vṛttikārastu ityārabhya pañcama- sūtrīyaṃ sarvaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vṛttikāramataṃ iti spaṣṭaṃ bhavati |

tena ānandāśramīyāt anyathā sidhyati |
vṛhattamapi nirālambanavādāt prāk ' ataḥ siddhaṃ yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ yasya ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ sa evāsamīcīnaḥ pratyayo nānyaḥ iti ' ityupasaṃhṛtam |
ṛjuvimalāyāṃ ca, ' adhikaraṇārthamupasaṃharati - ataḥ siddhamiti ' ityanena vṛhatīgranthaḥ avatāritaḥ |
nirālambana- vādānte ca śūnyavādatvāt prāk ' daurbalyaṃ ca kāryākṣamatvaṃ, na kāryāntaraupattitasāmarthyaṃ ityuktaṃ vṛttikāragranthe ' ityuktvāt nirālambanavādārambhāt prāgeva vṛttikāragranthaḥ samāpta iti spaṣṭaṃ bhavati |
vṛttikāramatārambhe ca ' vaktavyaṃ ca ( nimittaparīkṣaṇaṃ ) nirālambanatānirākaraṇārtham |

vaktavyaṃ punaḥ kimapyadarthāntaraṃ ? ucyate, pūrvoktasya sūtranayārthasya sādhanabhūtaṃ anyadarthāntaramanenoktaṃ pradarśayitum |
tathā ca tatstato'nyasya : lakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ ca sarvapramāṇānām ' iti vṛhatīgranthaḥ |
ṛjuvimalāyāṃ ca ' pūrvoktavyākhyāne hi ( pratyakṣasūtrasya ) na lakṣaṇaparatā, kiṃtu animittaparatā |
asmiṃstu ( vṛttikāra- ) vyākhyāne lakṣaṇaparatvena tatprayogasūtrasya pradarśanārthatayā sarvapramāṇalakṣaṇābhidhānaṃ sidhyati |
sarvapramāṇalakṣaṇopayogastu avyabhicārapradarśanane nirālambananirāsaḥ ' ityuktam |
etenāpi nirālambanavādāt prāgeva vṛttikāragranthasamāptau na kaścidvirodhaḥ |

‘bhāṣyakāraḥ saptabhiḥ sūtraiḥ ( 7|1|19-22 [ 20-23 ke. ], 23-25 [ 24-26 ke. ] ) adhikaraṇadvayameva vyākhyāyau’ ityupakramya vyākhyāya ante ‘ataḥ bhāṣya- kārate'pi na vārtikoktadūṣaṇāvakāśaḥ’ ityupasaṃhṛtam |
punaśca ‘vārtikakāramatopapādanaṃ tu’ ityupakramya tadupapāditam |
vastutastu yūpakārye khallevālīvidhānāt yūpaśabdasya na saṃskārādiśaktatvaṃ, saṃskārā- tideśastu sthānāpatyā iti sūtroktayūpatanto'pi asaṃgata eva |
bhāṣyakāroktaṃ asya ( sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapet-- prayājeprayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti ityasya ) vacanodāharaṇatvamapi pañcamavidhaprakārāpatteḥ āyuktam |
bhāṣyakārasya tu etādṛśaviṣaye ( guṇakāmeṣu ) phalotpatti manyamānasya abhiprāyaṃ na vidmaḥ |
yattu pārthasārathinā vārtikasvarasyāt āgneyatvamabhyupagamya ( abhimarśana-) mantrayoḥ dvyarthatvena vikalpān ekasmin āgneye pradhānāntarasāhityānurodhena prakṛtau vyavasthāyā- mapi vikṛtau tadabhāvena vyavasthākāraṇābhāvāt avyavasthitavikalpo mantrayoḥ iti siddhāntitaṃ, tat mantravikalpacintāyāḥ dvādaśe saṃgatatayā atideśavicārābhāvena adhyāyasaṃgatavyabhāvāpatteḥ āgneya- bhedasya ca sthāpitatvena aikyānupatteḥ upekṣitam |
( vastuto'tra vārtikanirāso'pi abhipretaḥ |
janakasatrātre ‘catvāri trivṛntyahāni’ iti catvāryanūdya trivṛttvavidhānena trivṛ- tvasya utpannaśiṣṭatvena durbalatvāt satānāmapi ahanāṃ dvādaśāhikāntargatasasāha- vikāratvaṃ iti bhāṣyakārāmiprāyaḥ |
vastutastu ayemeva trivṛttvaviśiṣṭakarmetividhiḥ |
yāni cātra mūle anekāni varṇakāni kṛtāni, tāni punaruktatvāt anupayukta- tvācca upekṣitāni |
mūlakāraistu granthavyākhyānarisakatayā kṛtāni iti dhyeyam |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa aśvamedhe ‘traidhātavīyā dīkṣaṇīyā bhavati’ iti vacanena dīkṣa- ṇīyākārye yajamānasaṃskāre vihitāyāṃ traidhātavīyāyāṃ pūrvapakṣe dīkṣaṇīyādharmaprāptiḥ, siddhānte tu prasiddhatraidhātavīyāyā dharmā eveti prayojanamuktaṃ, tanna, pūrvapakṣavat siddhānte'pi sthānāpattau bādhakābhāvāt |
vastutastu neyaṃ traidhātavīyāḥ kamīntaram |
ato dharmākāṅkṣā- viraheṇa ka sthānāpatyatideśapravṛttiḥ ? 9|12|
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa māsāgnihotre taddārambhake upāṃśutvasya ūhaḥ iti prayojanamuktaṃ, tat nāmātideśaprāptitasya viruddhavyāviruddha vā svarasya satve codanāliṅgātideśaprāpitopāṃśu- tvāprāpyanupapatteḥ upekṣitam |
yadapi vārtikādau ‘purastādupasadāṃ saumyena pracaranti’ ityādī upāṃśutvohaḥ ityuktaṃ, tadapi saumyamātrapuraskāreṇa kalpitasyātideśasya sāmānyavihitopāṃśutvāti- deśāpekṣayā prābalyādupekṣitam |
yattu mūle pūrvapakṣe ( yajñaṃ tanviṣpantau vācaṃ yacchataḥ iti ) yajñaśabdasya vistāra- viśeṣaṇatvamanaṅgīkṛtya bhāgadharmatvamuktaṃ, tat yajñaśabdasya vistāraṃ vinā anyatrānvayasya durupapāda- tvāt bhāgavācakapadāśravaṇācca upekṣitam |
vṛttikāreṇa tāvat evaṃ siddhāntitaṃ -- na agnyādhānamārambhapadārthaḥ; kiṃtu ‘idaṃ mayā kartavyaṃ’ iti saṃkalpaparaparyāyaḥ adhyavasāyaviśeṣaḥ |
tadarthā anvārambhaṇīyā anvādhāna- rahitāyāpi vikṛtau satvāt kartavyaiva |
prakṛtau ca āghānāttaraṃ sarvayāvajjīvikaprayogagāṇāṃ sakṛ- deva saṃkalpakaraṇāt sakṛdeva anvārambhaṇīyā iti |
tanna, tattatkālāvyavasthitatattajjīvanāsyanimitta- vaśena tattannimittakasarvayāvajjīvikaprayogagāṇāṃ tattatkāle evopasthitatvena adhyavasāyāpattau sarva- sādhāraṇādhyavasāye pramāṇābhāvāt |
tasmāt evaṃ bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ siddhāntitaṃ- adhyavasāyavācī ārambhaśabdaḥ |
apravṛttapravartanameva ārambhaḥ |
tadarthā anvārambhaṇīyā kartāramārambhayogyaṃ karoti, iti darśapūrṇamāsodeśyakāpravṛttapravartanavidhirūpaprathamaprayogīyādyapadārthaṃ ārambhaṇīyā |
sā ca prakṛtyarthaṃ sakṛt kāryā iti |
yattu mūle prathamaprayogārambhe kriyamāṇā ārambhaṇīyā sarvaprayogaṇāmupakaroti, ataḥ prathamaprayogārambhe kṛtaiva sarveṣāmupakārikā ityuktaṃ, tat anvārambhaṇīyājanyasyopakārasya yāva-
jīvasattve vikṛtiṣvapi prasaṅgāt upakārakatvāpatteḥ, asattve dvitīyādiprayoge'pi upakārakatvā- nāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
9|1|11, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa (devasya tvetyādinirvāpamantre) gauṇyā aśviśabdaḥ ādhāne aśvadānakaraṇāt daṃpattiparaḥ ityādinā nirvāpaviśeṣatvamupapāditaṃ, tat vede āropakapuruṣā- bhāvāt āhāryāropābhāvamabhipretya |
9|1|12, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa 'barhiṣpiṭṭheṣu mādhyaṃdinaṃ savanaṃ' iti liṅgamapi pragrayane evo- papadyate |
atra hi na yathāśrutaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyamupapadyate bādhāt |
ato jaghanyamādhyaṃdinasavana- pade eva lakṣaṇāṅgīkṛtya mādhyaṃdinasavanasaṅghabhūtā yāḥ sāmavede samāmnātāḥ, tāḥ paṣṭhiḥ ityarthāvagatiḥ ityuktaṃ, tat lakṣaṇāyā āvaśyakatve lāghavāt mādhyaṃdinasavanastotrīyāṇāmeva lakṣaṇāt (dāśata- yībhyaḥ) ānītānāmapi tattvopapatteḥ upekṣitam |
9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 2, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa anyayorvā anuṣṭhumoḥ samānayanaṃ pragrayanaṃ vā iti cintitaṃ, tat paunaruktyāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 2, bhāṣyakārīyaṃ naudhasagrahaṇaṃ naudhasasmārakabrāhmaṇācchaṃsitopalakṣaṇārthaṃ, tasya bṛha- tsāmapṛṣṭhatvena śyatasyaiva prasaktau naudhasaprasaktyabhāvāt, gavāmayane abhīvartasyaiva brahmasāmatvena viśiṣṭa vihitatvāt |
9|1|6 varṇakaṃ 4, mūle tatkāryakāritvarūpāṃ sthānāpattiṅgīkṛtya tasyāḥ pañcavidhatvamuktam |
yadyapi ca sarvatra vidhaureva sthānāpattau bījaṃ, tathāpi tatsahakārīṇi pañca iti pañcavidhatvam |
9|1|11, mūloktaṃ sthānāpannatvaṃ nirasya mūloktodāharaṇāmāpi āyuktatvaṃ pratipādya 'ato mūloktaprakārā- nupapatteḥ evaṃ vācyaṃ' ityuktvā prakārāntaraṃ uktaṃ udāharaṇāni ca vivṛtāni bhāṣye |
9|1|11, bhāṣyakāreṇa kaṇṭharaṃtere bṛhadrathaṃtaryoḥ aviruddhasaṃmīlanādidharmāṇāṃ samuccayaḥ viruddhacaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu vikalpaḥ iti iṣṭāpatyaiva samāhitam |
vārtikakārastu saṃmīlanādīnāṃ aicchiko vikalpa eva (na samuccayaḥ) ityāha |
9|1|15, yattu mūle prakṛtāveva nāvatrātasya tattvena vidheyatā, api tu apūrvasādhanaviśeṣo- pāyatvena ityuktaṃ, tanna, tathātve prakṛtāveva vrīhiparyāyāṇāṃ vidalanādeśānuṣṭhāne vaiguṇyāpatteḥ |
yattu mūle etatpakṣasādhanārthaṃ (paḍviṃśatirasya vaṅkyaḥ ityatra śrutapadasyāvṛttiḥ iti pakṣasya) paḍviṃśatisaṃkhyāpaśumyasaṃbandhapradhānamidaṃ vākyaṃ pratipaśu bhedena tatsaṃbandhaṃ prakāśayituṃ abhyasanīyaṃ iti yuktirupapannatā, sā saṃvandhasya paṣṭhyarthasya guṇatvena prādhānyaśaṅkā'nupapatteḥ |
vākyārtharūpasya ca aśābdatvena sūtratāṃ tadanupapatteḥ, prādhānye'pi ca tasya pratipūhane'pi prakāśanopapatteḥ abhyāse pramāṇābhāvāt upekṣitā |
atra ca (9|1|7|21 sūtreṣu) sūtravyākhyā'nurodhena kiñcidailakṣyaṇyeṇa bhāṣya- kāreṇa aikādhikaraṇyaṃ vārtikakāreṇa ca adhikaraṇadvayamāśritaṃ, tat prameyamātralekhanapravṛttena mayā upekṣitam |
9|1|12, bhāṣyakārādibhireva samāhitaṃ (praśasā bāhū ityatra) pratyakṣavihitasvadhitisattve māntravarṇikaśāsavidhikalpanāyāṃ gauravāt praśāsāpadaṃ praśastatvaparameva iti, tacca svayameva 'daśa prayājāniṣṭvā āha śāsamāhara' iti vākyasya likhitatvāt śāsasyāpi paśau vihitatvena upe- kṣitam |
9|1|14, yattu mūle varṇakāntareṇa 'prājāpatyaṃ ghṛte caruṃ nirvapet śatakṛṣṇalamāyuṣkāmaḥ' ityudāhṛtya kṛṣṇaleṣu vitṛptībhāvarūpaprayojanābhāvāt avaghātasya bādhaḥ ityuktaṃ, tat kṛṣṇalānāṃ pradeyacaruprakṛtitvaṃ kṛtvācintyā |
10|1|1, sautrāmaṇyāṃ āśvinādidevatyasya prākṛtameva kāryaṃ, aindrāgnādidevatyasya tu aprākṛta- miti sūtrabhāṣyakārayorbhiprāyaḥ |
vārtikakārastu guṇāt karmāntarameva prākṛtapaśupuroḍāśakāryapanaṃ darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtikaṃ vidhīyate iti |
10|1|19, yattu mūle yatra yajamānasya guṇatvaṃ, tatra asnnāmeva śukrānvārambhādī anetanāmapi anvārambhānukūlasthiniṣṭhavyāpārāśrayatayā kartṛtvopapatteḥ asthibhaiva anvārambhādi kāryamityuktaṃ, tatredaṃ vācyaṃ, prakṛtau hi yajamānapadavācyo yāgakartā jīvātmaiva kartṛtvenogyate |
śarīrasya tu na kartṛtvam |
ātmanaśca kartṛtvaṃ kṛtvāśrayatvenaiva, na ca mṛtasya tādṛśakartṛtvāsaṃbhavaḥ |
ato varaṃ pradhāne eva anumatitaddārakaṃ mṛtātmakartṛtvamupapāya acyurṇaiva te kāryaḥ iti |
10|1|18, yattu mūle prākṛtaguṇakānāṃ mṛtādhikārapakṣe apravṛttirityuktaṃ, tat aṣṭame eva teṣāṃ vikṛtau apravṛtterityuktatvāt, kṛtvācintyā kathane prayojanābhāvāt upekṣitam |
bārhaspatye satadaśaśarāve saṃkhyānurodhāt sapādacatuḥśarāvaparimitaṃ pātraṃ kṛtvā tena caturvāraṃ nirvāpaḥ ityarthaḥ bhāṣyakārādibhiḥ karkādimiśra sarvairnirṇitaḥ |
mama tu pratibhāti sākṣātsādhanībhūtāgnihotrahavaṇayāḥ muṣṭīnāṃ ca bādhāpekṣayā saṃkhyāyā ekaikasyāḥ muṣṭiparicchedadvārā nirvāpasādhanībhūtāyāḥ bādha ucitaḥ |
vastutastu na tasyā api bādhaḥ |
yāgīyayāvadravyasattvā- rukanirvāpavṛttimuṣṭiparicchedakatvasya bādhe'pi adoṣatvāt |
tattvaṃ tu īśvaro vetti |
10|1|27, loke pūrvaṃ hi cidagrahaṇāṃ yavānāṃ bharjanottaraṃ punaravādhānalaprasiddheḥ prayojanānurodhena prākṛtakramaṃ bādhitvā'pi bharjanottaraprāptaṃ : sadharmakaṃ : kartavyaḥ iti bhāṣyabhiprāyaḥ |
vārtikakārastu dvivāramavahatanāmaye dhānātvam |
pūrvameva samyak vitṛpīkṛtānāṃ
yavānāṃ bharjane kṛte dhānātvāpyateḥ |
ato yathāprakṛtyaiva avaghātasya bharjanāta pūrvameva anuṣṭhāno- papatteḥ nātra dhānā udāharaṇaṃ api tu manyaḥ iti |
10|2|33, yattu atra bhāṣyakāreṇa śyene 'nīvītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti' ityājñātena prayogā- jhabhūtakartṛsaṃskārakeṇa nīvītena atideśaprāptasya sarvakarmārthatvena vihitasya copavītasya bādhamāśa- ṅkya adyarthatvāt samuccayaḥ iti siddhāntitaṃ, tacca asyādyarthatve śrāddhādāvapi prācīnavītena saha upavītasya samuccayāpatteḥ |
yāvajjīvaikarātrisatravatantakayajñopavītadhāraṇāśritaprakāraviśeṣasya upavītatvanivītatvādeḥ tattatkarmajñayā vihitasya samuccayāsaṃbhavāt upekṣitam |
yadapi ‘saṃsthite ṣaḍahe maghāśayet’ iti vihitamaśvaśanena prākṛtapayotratasya tasminnahani nivṛtti- māśāṅkya adyarthatvādeva samuccaya ityuktaṃ, tat maśvaśanesya dehavṛttyanarhatvena payovratakāryakāri- tvānupapatteḥ pūrvapakṣotthānābhāvāt sutyāyāṃ payovratābhāvācca upekṣitam |
10|4|11, agnisāṃ dvirātre 'vaikhānasaṃ pūrvairhan sāma bhavati, ṣoḍasyuttare' ityatra vṛttikāreṇa ṣoḍasyuttare ityayamapūrvavidhiḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā 'ṣoḍasyuttare' ityanena 'uttarehan dvimātrasya' ityasyopasaṃhārāt dvimātrāntare ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavikalpasya bādhaḥ iti siddhāntitam |
bhāṣyakāreṇa tu upasaṃhāraḥ iti pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā stāvakatvaṃ iti siddhāntitam |
10|5|13, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa aupadeśikīṃ tryanīkāmāmuktaiva ātideśikīṃ dvādaśāhikīṃ navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīṃ tryanīkāṃ gāvāmayanepūrvapakṣasi prāptāmudāhṛtya daṇḍakalitavadāvṛtyā pūrvapakṣaṃ kṛtvā svasthānavivṛddhisiddhānto liṅgadarśanaṃ ca vyākhyātam |
tanna |
dvādaśāhāntargatadaśāhapravṛ- ttereva sarvavikṛtiṣu sādhitatvena navāhaḥsaṃbandhinīkāmāprāpteḥ ayuktisahatvāt |
ataḥ yathā- vārtikaṃ aupadeśikīṃ tryanīkāmādāyaiva adhikaraṇaṃ yojyam |
etāvattu vārtikakārate'pi cinta- nīyaṃ- yatra prakṛtau nyūnabhāgavṛttidharmaḥ, vikṛtau ca sa bhāgaḥ adhikadinaghaṭitaḥ, adhikāni ca dināni na prākṛtatadbhāgaprakṛtikāni yathā atraiva aupadeśikatryanīkābhāve kṛtvācintayā, tatra tadbhāgadharmaprāptiḥ kathamiti |
10|5|25, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa (maśvaśasya) prakaraṇāt dvādaśāhāhvayamityuktaṃ, tat vaimṛdhe'pi tadāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
yadapi tena maśvaśasya yāṃ ca yāvatīṃ ca mātrāṃ tṛptijananāt taduttara- kartavyadarthopakārakatvapratīteḥ dvādaśāhāhvayaṃ ityuktaṃ, tadapi tathālye tādṛśadvitripadārthamātrā- jñāvāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
10|6|19, sūtrāṇyapi asminnarthe yojanīyāni |
10|8|10, sūtrabhāṣyorapi asminnarthe (svāhākāraṣaṭkārayorvasthitavikalpaḥ ityarthe ) yojanā sudhībhiḥ ihonneyā |
yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa idaṃ 'savyā vā etarhi vapā0' iti liṅgaṃ akarmāntaratve prayāja- śeṣasya ṛtupaśuvāpyabhidhāreṇa riktatvāt anabhibhūtatvaṃ yujyate, karmāntaratve tu tadarthaṃ punaḥ prayājakaraṇāt tenaiva tadpā'bhidhāreṇopapatteḥ anabhibhūtatvadarśanaṃ na yuktamiti vyākhyātaṃ, tat karmāntaratvapakṣe'pi mādhyandinakālīnapaśupuroḍāśasavanīyahaviṣābhiva savanīyatantramadhyāpattivena prasāṅgatyā prayājapunaḥkaraṇānāpatteḥ upekṣitam |
11|2|11, bhāṣyakāreṇa tāvat agneḥ sarvārthatvāt sāṅgapradhānārthaḥ agniyogaḥ, ataḥ anervimokaḥ sarvānte eva kāryaḥ iti pūrvapakṣiśate pradhānānte eva vimokaḥ iti siddhāntitam |
vārtikakāraṇaṃ tu bhāṣyakārokyayuktyaiva pradhānamātrārthatvamabhiyogasya pūrvapakṣīkṛtya sāṅgapradhānārthatvasiddhānte eva sūtrāṇi vyākhyātāni |
11|3|19, yattu codakaprayogavidhyorubhayoḥ sattve'pi prayojanābhāvāt ( paśupuroḍāśe ājyabhāgādīnāṃ ) nānuṣṭhānaṃ iti prābhākaramataṃ, tat vidhinā vihitasya guṇaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasya prayājāderanuṣṭhāne vihitaguṇābhāvena prayojanalābhābhāvātpatteḥ upekṣitam |
yattu asminnadhikaraṇe mūle prayogavidhimaṅgīkṛtya codakalopena pūrvapakṣakaraṇaṃ, codakāṅgīkāreṇa prayogavidhimātrātlopena ca siddhāntakaraṇaṃ, tat niryuktikatvāt prayojanābhāvācca upekṣitam |
12|1|12, yattu atra sūtrakārādibhiḥ aṅgīkṛtyaiva dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ pradhānamātrārthatvaṃ pradhānadeva- tāyāṃ vaiśvadevagṛhītāyāṃ viśvaśandasya sarvavācitvaṃ sarvebhāmeva devānāṃ devatātvapratīteḥ aṅgedevatānāmapi tatparigraheṇa parigrahāt prasaṅgopapattiḥ iti samāhitaṃ, tat viśvadeva- śabdasya 'ādityaviśvevasaḥ' iti trikāṇḍīsmaraṇena gaṇaviśeṣe rūḍhatvāgateḥ dīkṣaṇīyāyāḥ devatāparigrahāryatvapakṣe pradhānamātrārthatve pramāṇābhāvācca upekṣitam |
12|1|12, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa pañcadaśarātre agniṣṭuti prathamāhe bhūyo'nugrahāya aindrī kāryā ityuktaṃ, tat subrahmaṇyā''hvānasya devatāprakāśanārthatvāt indraprakāśana ca agniprakāśanarūpakārya- siddherevāt bhedenaiva ubhayadevatyasubrahmaṇyākaraṇāvagateḥ upekṣitam |
12|1|17, vṛttikārāntareḥ bhūyastvaṃ na mukhyatvasyāpavādakaṃ, kiṃtu paśukāmeṣṭyāmeva bhūyastvena pūrvapakṣamidhāya mukhyatvena siddhāntayitvā aikādhikaraṇyena sūtradvayaṃ vyākhyeyamityuktaṃ, tat loke prathamaṃ alpamūlyāvaruddhasyāpi durgasya paścādāgatairapi bahubhirbhāradharpaṇāt upekṣitam |
12|1|18, yattu bhāṣyakāreṇa somānte 'saṃsthite yajñe prastaraṃ praharati savastraṃ' iti pāśuka- svaroḥ pratipattidarśanādapi savanīyapaśutantrasya vitatatvaṃ ityuktaṃ, tat svaroḥ paśutrayasādhāraṇatvādeva ante pratipattidarśanenopapatteḥ nāsādhāraṇaṃ savanīyatantravitatatve liṅgaṃ ityupekṣitam |

tathāpi liṅgasaṃvyāptiprasaṅgamātrasya bhāvanā'nvaya- niyamena ( nipātopasargaprātipadikatiriktācchabdamyo yaḥ supāttulliṅgasaṅkhyāvyatiriktaḥsthaiḥ, tatyakāraśabdabuddhi- tvācchaccaṃ prati liṅgasanvayibhāvanāvācipādajanyaupasthi- tirviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena kāraṇaṃ, ityevaṃ prakāratāniyāmaka- vyutpatti mīmāṃsakairarthavādagadaṅgīkṛtāmanurudhya |

vibhaktyarthatvaṃ ca vibhaktiśaktyagamyato na nimittatvādikamādāya nimittā- dāvityarthāḥ, saptamyā adhikaraṇatvārthatvena nimittatve śakyatvābhāvāt |

anayaiva rītyā ' somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirva- pet kuṇānāṃ vrīhīṇām ' ityādau karaṇatvasya ṣaṣṭhīlakṣya- tve'pi śrīhīṇāṃ yāgāṅgatvamupapādanīyam |

aṅgapradhānayo: ekadeśakālakartṛkatvam ||
aṅgeṣu ca tadabhāvaḥ pradhānaṃ prati nirdeśāt yathā dravyadevatvam |
bhāṣyaṃ- aṅgeṣu idānīṃ vicāryate |
kiṃ teṣāṃ samā- daya eva deśakālakartāraḥ, athavā aniyamaḥ iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? aṅgeṣu ca tadabhāvaḥ |
kutaḥ ? pradhānaṃ prati nirdeśāt |
codanāvidhiśeṣatvena āgneyādīni pradhānāni prati samādayo nirdiṣṭā nānyatra bhavanti |
tasmādaniyamaḥ |
yathā dravyadevataṃ yat pradhāneṣu na tadaṅgeṣu, evaṃ deśadayo- 'pi |
( madhye antarāgārbhiṇī anyatra gṛhyatam |
) aṅgāni tu vidhānatvāt pradhānānopadidyere- stasmāt syādekadeśatvam |
bhāṣyaṃ- yaduktaṃ aṅgeṣu deśādīnāmanīyama iti, tatra, aṅgeṣu samādiniyama iti |
kutaḥ ? yataḥ aṅgā- nyapi pradhānena phalasiddhau upadiśyamānena saha upadiśyante |
kathaṃ ? vidhānatvāt |
pradhānānāṃ phalaṃ sādhyatāṃ vidhānametat, yaduta aṅga- prayogaḥ |
vidhānaṃ, kalpaḥ, itikrtavyatā ityarthaḥ |
ato ' darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargakāmo yajeta ' ityatra aṅgavān prayogaḥ pradhānānāmuktaḥ |
yathāvidhiḥ : tatroktaḥ, tathāvidhena punaḥ śrutyā samādīnāṃ vidhiḥ |
ataḥ aṅgānāmapi pradhānaiḥ saha ekadeśakālakartṛkatvaṃ syāt |
dravyadevataṃ tatheti cet |
bhāṣyaṃ- atha yaduktaṃ, yathā dravyadevataṃ pradhānānā- maṅgānāṃ ca bhedena bhavati, evaṃ deśadayo'pi sphuriti |
tat parihartavyam |
āmāpāntaṃ sūtram |
na codanāviśiṣṭeṣvanyathāviśeṣaḥ |
bhāṣyaṃ- naitadevam |
kutaḥ ? codanāvidhiśeṣatvāt |
codanāvidhiśeṣo hi dravyadevatāvidhiḥ |
tena pradhānaiṣu dravyadevatāviśeṣo niyataḥ |
iha agniḥ puroḍāśaśca, iha āyanaṃ abhīṣṭaumī ceti |

na cānyatra nirdiṣṭaḥ |
tasya ca prayogaḥ sādhāraṇāt tantrabhāvaḥ ityadiṣṭho hetuḥ |
tasmāt viṣamaṃ dravyadevatena |
teṣu samavetānāṃ samavāyāttantramaṅgāni, bhedastu tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
prayoge syāt, teṣāṃ pradhāna- śabdatvāt, tathā cānyārthadarśanam |
bhāṣyaṃ- yadi ca samānaṃ dravyadevataṃ aṅgānāṃ pradhā- nānāṃ syāt, tattatteṣu dravyadevateṣu samavetānā- maṅgānāṃ pradhānānāṃ ca samavāyāt tadavasthaḥ aviśeṣaḥ, iti tantramaṅgiyā syāt |
medastu tadbhedāt |
atha tu bhedo dravyadevatvasya, tataḥ tadbhedāt karmabhedaḥ |
prayoge syāt |

śā— puruṣādyopāttadravyatāṃ lābhāt nādravyasya tadarjanaṃ kratubhirākṣipyate |
ato viduṣāmiva dravyatā- madhikāraḥ |
netat tulyam |
vidyā hi pratyakṣaviśiṣṭā trayāṇāṃ, iti tadaiva upapannāḥ ṛtavaḥ, na śuddhasya (vidyāṃ) ākṣipanti iti yuktam |
(nanu vidhyantarā- bhāve'pi bhojanādyarthamupāttaṃ yasya dravyamasti, tat eva kratuyajñasidhdeḥ adravyasya na kratumindrayākṣepaḥ |
ityata āha—) dravyārjanaṃ tu sarvapuruṣāṇāṃ dravyakāryaiva ākṣetavyam |
tatrāviśeṣatvāt bhojanādivat ṛtanāmapi tadākṣepatvaṃ na vāryate |
(bhavedevaṃ yadi 'bhojanādimareva dravyākṣepaṃ, na kratumiḥ' iti niyame kiṃ cit pramāṇaṃ syāt |
bhojanādayo'pi hi dravyakāryatvāt dravyamākṣipanti ityetāvanmātram |
tathā sati kratorapi dravyakāryatvāviśeṣeṇa bhojanāditulyatayā dravyākṣepatvaṃ avarjanīyam |
na caitāvatā arjananiyamasya kratvarthatvaprasaṅgaḥ |
śrutyādyābhāvāt arjanasya kratuvyabhicārācca) ataḥ adravyo'pi dravyamarjayitvā kuryāt |
vi— 'dhanyava kratoranyo'pi, dhanveva vidhipasāryataḥ |
anyo'dhikurute dravyamākṣipad bhuktitvat kratuḥ |
' 'dhanī dravyavān eva kartā uta anyo'pi iti saṃśayaḥ |
sārthyataḥḥ sārthyakyāt |
bhāṭṭa— agnidhrayorva dravyasyāpi pratigrahādi- puruṣādyopāyavidhivalādeva labdhatayā kratuvidhibhirākṣe- pāt paramayutpattisiddhadravyata eva adhikāraḥ, na tu asiddha- dravyasya tadarjavitvā |
iti prāpte, pratigrahādya upāyavidherapi anujñāvidhitvāt dravyasya sthāpitatvāt (4|1|2 varṇakaṃ 3) dravya svatantravidhiprayuktatvābhāvena jīvanādiprakāreṇaiva kratunā'pi tadākṣepaupapatteḥ pratigrahādepi saṃbhogaprayaktva- nyāyena (4|1|3|1) kratvarthatvasya sthāpitatvāt prayā- jādivat kratunā'pi tadākṣepaupapatteśca adravyo'pi dravya- marjayitvā adhikriyate eva |
nyāyabinduḥ— evameva, siddhadravyāṇāmevādhikāraḥ, kratubhirdravyārjanākṣepe gauravāt |
iti prāpte, dravyasya prayojanavadojanātnāt bhojanādivat kratunāmapi tadākṣepa- kalyamaviruddham |
vidyā tu na rāgaprāptā, kintu pratyakṣavidhi- siddhaiva gṛhyate iti bheda iti siddhāntaḥ |

purohitaśca tacchabdavācyaḥ |
śrutyā, na rājā |

dup— abhinnakalyānāmādhikāraḥ iti pūrvatra sthitam |
iha rājapurohitau iti bhinnakalpayoradhikāraḥ iti prati- pādayituṃ adhikaraṇam |
(rājapurohitau iti) kimayaṃ ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaikaśeṣaḥ, uta kṛtaikaśeṣeṇa uttarapadena tatpuruṣaḥ, uta samānādhikaraṇaikaśeṣaḥ, uta dvaṃdvaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ |
tatra na tāvat kṛtasamāsasya ekaśeṣaḥ |
rājaśabdānarthakyāt |
rājña eva hi sa bhavati |

na samā- nādhikaraṇaikaśeṣaḥ, rājñaḥ apurohitatvāt |
dvaṃdvo'stu iti siddhāntaḥ |
bhinnakalpayoḥ iha adhikāraḥ |
arthābhāvāt naivaṃ syāt |

kutaḥ ? arthābhāvāt |
naivāyamartho'sti, dvau purohitau iti |

ekatvaṃ vivakṣitam |
nanu vacanādityuktam |
ucyate ; na tu vacanādetat śakyaṃ, saṃskāranimittatvāt purohitaśabdasya |
kriyamāṇo'pi na purohitaḥ syāt |
arthānāṃ ca vibhaktatvāt tacchrutena saṃbandhaḥ |
bhāṣya— arthānāṃ ca vibhaktyaṃ śrūyate 'tejaḥ- saṃstaro brāhmaṇasya' 'vīryasaṃstabo rājanyasya' tābhyāṃ varṇābhyāṃ tenena phalena saṃbandho'nūyate |
tasmādapi na dvau purohitau ekasya rājña iti |
pāṇe: pratyajñabhāvādsaṃbandhaḥ pratīyate |
bhāṣya— atha yadukta etasādeva kāraṇāt ekasyaiva puruṣasya dvau pāṇī bhavata iti |
yuktaṃ tatra, pāṇe: pratyajña- bhūtatvāt |
añjalau pratyajñabhūtaḥ dakṣiṇasya pāṇe: savyaḥ pāṇiḥ |
tena vinā añjalirena na bhavati |
na hi dvābhyāṃ dakṣiṇābhyāṃ añjalirlapyate |

soma— pūrvopavādāt saṃgatiḥ |
yadyapi prajādādiṣu tulyaḥ kalpo rājapurohitayorapi saṃbhavati, tathāpi 'havi- ṣkṛdāgahī rājanyasya' 'tamasmai bhakṣaṃ prayacchet' ityevaṃ bahuśo rājanyasya kalpānnāmāne rājanyapuro- hitayoḥ ekarūpaprayogasya atyantasaṃbhavitvāt bhinna- kalpamavarjanīyam |
vi— 'sāyujyakāmau yajato'nena rājapurohitau |
rājñaḥ purohitau rājauvā rājāmakāmubhau |
dvayordvaṃdva- samāso vā, tulyatvāyābhimo dvayoḥ |
siddhaye dvitīyo rājoktisārthyatvāya tṛtīyaḥ |
, adhyāhṛtye caturthaḥ syāt vacanādvibhaktyalpatā |

' bhāṭṭa— 'etena rājapurohitau sāyujyakāmau yaje- yātāṃ' ityatrāpi na bhinnakalpayoradhikāraḥ |
dvaṃdvasya yugapaddhikaraṇavacanatvena padadvaye'pi lakṣaṇātvāt, tada- naṅgīkāre'pi vā sāhityavārthe padadvaye lakṣaṇāyā āva- śyakatvāt |

ataḥ tatpuruṣa evāyaṃ, tattattvaṃ ca ekaśeṣaḥ |
ataśca samāsāttvaṃ dvivacanaṃ tadarthasyaiva dvivahaḥ |

dvivacanasya viśeṣaṇyavivakṣyupatteḥ saṃbhyādhikaraṇe (6|1|12) vyutpāditāt ekasya anekasya vā rājño dvau purohitau, ityaparaḥ |
athavā ekaśeṣaṃ kṛttvaiva tatpuruṣaḥ kāryaḥ, itarathā padadvayāvṛtti- prasaṅgāt rājapadadvayasyadharmasaṅgāt |

iti prāpte, brāhmaṇā- nāmeva paurohityaśravaṇāt karmadhārayānupapatteḥ dvaṃdva evā- yam |
na ca tatra padadvaye lakṣaṇā, yugapaddhikaraṇavacana- tvasya nirākṛtatvāt (6|1|12) |
na ca sāhityapratītyarthe lakṣaṇā, tattadītarāmānikatvenāpi upapattau lakṣaṇāyā pramāṇabhāvāt |
samāhāre paraṃ ekatvānvayārthe padadvaye'pi samudāyalakṣaṇā iti viśeṣaḥ |
vastutastu itaretaradvaṃdva'pi vyāpyabhāvena sāhityapratīteḥ ānumānikatvāyogān avaśyaṃ pratīyamānasya tasya yadyapi lakṣaṇikatvamāyadyaka- meva, tathāpi tallakṣaṇayā ekaśeṣe'pi samānatvena sarva- pakṣeṣu āvaśyakatvāt pūrvoktayuktyā dvaṃdvopapattiḥ |
ataśca rājaḥ purohitaśca ca bhinnakalpayorapi adhikāraḥ |
purohito'pi tasyaiva rājñaḥ, purohitatvasya sasaṃvanyakatvena rājapratiyogitvasyaiva saṃbhavāt aihikasya ekarājyapatitvarūpa- sāyujyaphalakatvasya anyānupapatteḥ |
astu vā anyasyāpi |

tatrāpi na vikalpaḥ |

yadi cānupapattyabhāve'pi anyatra dṛṣṭamiti kṛtvā'dhikāraḥ kalpyate, tataḥ phalaparyantaṃ kāmyeṣu dṛṣṭamiti naimitti- kaniṣedhavidhivorapi tatparyantaṃ syāt, na caitadiha manyate |

athāpi kathaṃ cidvicaryate, tathāpi vidheratatpara- tvācca vaidhatvaṃ vicārasya sidhyati |
avaidhaśca na vaidhaṃ snānamupakruṣṭumarhati |
yadi dhyāyanavidhividhāyanamartha- jñānāvasānaṃ viddhyāt tatastena vicāramantareṇārthasya jñānamupakravyatvādidvāro'pyadhyāśitaḥ svavicchadaṃ snānamuka- paॅntu |
yadā tvadhyayanamātreṇaiva vidhau'nuṣṭhitaḥ, tadā na vidhistatvāddicārādanuṣṭhānamākṣipatti |

upadeṣṭṛlabhe cāsāvanujñīyate, tato nādhyayanamyavanānantareṇasyānuṣṭhānaṃ sidhyet |
nanvadhyayanāṅgabhūto vicāraḥ; na cānaṅgena karaṇena vidhiḥ sidhyatīti vidhivaiva svasiddhayarthe vicāramanuṣṭhā- payatīti kathamaidhatvaṃ vicārasya |
satyamadhyāyanaṃ vicāraḥ, tathāpi na vidhisiddhāvuyujyate, arthajñānādyakāryayogā- tyān |
na ca kāryāntaropayogyāṅgaṃ kāryāntareṇa tadekakaraṇake- nāpi dṛṣṭikāmāputryeṇa saubharakaraṇakenādhyāpanāpūrvopa- yogilaubhirāṅgaṃ ūrdhvaninaṃ prayujyate |
atha vidhividhārtha- jñānādhyāyanasyāttvāt tādṛgbhigrayasaṃsparśasya vicāramākṣi- pattītyucyate, tadadhyāpanavidhividhiyuktaṃ vicāraṃ nirākurva- dvirassāmirnirākṛtam |

śakyate kartuṃ tasmai epa samākhyāyate, śakyate cānena padārtho'bhidhātuṃ, śakyate ca kriyākāle pratipattum |
tasmā- dedaḥ padārthāḥ śātumupādeyāḥ kriyākāle ca pratipattum |

(bahuḥ pāṭhabhedo'tra ) yatra tu mantro vidhyate, tatra tasyānyārthatvāt |
vidhāyakasya tu vidhānenāpi kṛtārtha- tvāmantrasyaiva sārakatvam |
ata eva tatra mantrakrameṇaiva padārthānuṣṭhānaṃ na vidhikameṇa, tatra brāhmaṇakramo japayasā- dāvupayujyate, tathā phalavatpratipādākanāmapi phalavatprati- vistārena |
tasmiṃśca dṛṣṭārthatve'pi adhyayanavidhirmārthatvā- dānarthakyābhāvād arthajñānāthametyanam |

adhyayanavidhivicāraḥ |
'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' iti vedārthajñānāya adhyayanavidhiḥ |
atra hi vidhau karmaṇi tavyapratyayaḥ |
utpādyatvaṃ āpyatvaṃ saṃskāryaṃ vā vā karmatvaṃ yathā 'ghaṭaṃ karoti', 'grāmaṃ gacchati' 'vrīhīn prokṣati' iti |
adhyayanaṃ ca bhāvārthādhikaraṇa- nyāyena ( 2|1|1 varṇakaṃ 2 ) bhāvanāyāṃ karaṇatvena anveti |
svādhyāyasya ca tena utpādyatvasaṃbhavāt āpyatvaṃ saṃskāryaṃ vā karmatvaṃ bhavati |
tataśca 'adhyayanena svādhyāyaṃ prāpnuyāt' iti vacanavyaktiḥ, 'adhyayanena svādhyāyaṃ saṃskuryāt' iti vā |
tatra adhyayanena avāsya saṃskṛtasya vā svādhyāyasya svataḥ apuśārtha- tvāt phalakāṅkṣāyāṃ abhītavedajanyadharmāvabodhasya svargādisādhanatayā phalatvāt, sati ca saṃbhave adṛṣṭa- kalpanā'yogāt tameva prayojanavadarthāvabodhaparatāmaneyaṃ adhītasvādhyāyasyaḥ phalatvena gṛhṇāti, anārthādhyatasyāpi adhyayanasya sāmarthyādeva ṛtuvidyākṣitārthasāne upayoga- saṃbhavāt |
tataśca, 'adhītena svādhyāyena arthāvabodhaṃ bhāvayet' iti paryavasyo'rthaḥ |
tatra arthavādānāṃ vācya- vidhayā dharmapramitijananasaktyabhāve'pi kṛtsnasya vedasya prayojanavadarthāvabodhaparyavasānaṃ adhyayanavidhinaiva vidhyapekṣitaprāśastyāpayauryanamukhena utthāpitalakṣya- vidhayā tvatyatipādanadvārā vidhyupayogāt dharmaprāmāṇyamupa- padyate iti vārtikādigrantheṣu sthitam |
vastutastu svādhyāyavidhiḥ akṣarānupūrvadhāraṇārūpagrahaṇārthaḥ |
arthāva- bodhastu gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikasya svata eva bhavati, na tu tatra adhyayanavidhervyāpāraḥ, dharmāvabodhastvanye- nākātsyeprasaṅgāt |
brāhmaṇasya rājyābhāvena tanmantra- brāhmaṇadhyayanasya vyarthatvāt |
kiṃca agnihotrādilakṣaṇa- vedārthasya adhyayanāt prāk saṃdhyopāsanavat pitrādyupadeśato jñāne sati jñātatvādeva tadavabodhasya kāmyatvābhāvāt phalatvānupapattiḥ |
tataḥ prāk tajjñāne tu na sa kāmayituṃ śakyaḥ |
jñāte eva icchāniyamāt |
atha sāmānyato jñāte,
viśiṣṭe ajñāte tadicchā saṃbhavati |
pitrādyupadeśato viśi- ṣyāvagate'pi aupadeśikajñānasya prāmāṇyasya punartho- dhakāmanayā ca yuktā iti cenna |
agnihotrādiviśeṣajñānānāṃ hi na tāvat ekabuddhyā viśeṣākāreṇa uddeśaḥ, anantatvāt |
sāmānyākāreṇa uddeśe ca sāmānyajñānameva vidhiphalaṃ syāt, na tu viśeṣajñānam |
ataḥ arthāvabodhasya uddeśatvā- yogāt na phalatvam |
na ca adhyayanavidheḥ arthāvabodhānta- tvābhāve vedasya kathaṃ svārthe tātparyayogamḥ iti vācyam |
upakramādisāhakṛtaśabdādalādeva tatsaṃbhavāt |
tasmāt adhyayanavidhiḥ akṣaragrahaṇamātraphalaka eva |
tathā ca puru- pārthānuśāsanasūtrāṇi vedāmyodghāṭṭāni 'bodhāntatve- 'dhyayanākāṅkṣām' |
'so'kāmyaḥ : prāpnovyabhānā- bhānayoḥ' |
'uddeśāyogācca' ityādīni |
evaṃ ca vyāka- raṇamahābhāṣye paspaśāhnike 'brāhmaṇena niṣkāraṇo vedaḥ paḍaṅgo'dhyetavyo jñeyaśca' ityādāvapi śrutau 'jñeyaśca' iti pṛthak jñānavidhiḥ arthavān bhavati |
adhyayanavidheḥ bodhāntatve tu tadānarthakyaṃ spameva |
niṣkāraṇaḥ- kāryate anena iti kāraṇaṃ phalam |
dṛṣṭaprayojananirapekṣaḥ śikṣā- vyākaraṇādipadagrahasahito vedaḥ adhyayanena grāhyaḥ tadarthaśca pratipattavyaḥ |
so'yaṃ dharmo na dṛṣṭaphalaḥ, nitya iti yāvat |
tadabhāve hi pratyavāyaḥ smaryate 'sthāṇurya bhāra- hāraḥ kilābhūdadhītya vedaṃ na vijānāti yo'rtham' ityādiḥ |
na ca gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikasya svata eva jñānasaṃbhavāt tadvidhivyartha iti vācyam |
nahi adhyayanaṃ gṛhītapadārthasaṃgatikena bhāvyaṃ iti lokto labhyaṃ, acyutapraṇāmapi bahulamupalabhyāt, padapadārtha- saṃgatigrahaṇāmātasave'pi atigahanavedārthasya nyāya- vicāramantarā anupapatteḥ |
ataḥ padapadārthasaṃgati- madhigamya nyāyavicārato yathāvat vedārthajñānaṃ nitya- tathā vidhīyate |
tadapi svasvapidhādikramāgataveda- bhāgalāmātrasya, netarasya vedabhāgasya, svādhyāyavidhau svapadārthakyāpātāt |
tathā ca svādhyāyā adhyayanaṃ artha- jñānaṃ ca nityam |
itarājñānāṃ tu adhyayanaṃ arthajñānaṃ ca ṛtuvidhiprayuktaṃ ārthikameva, na ca tatra svādhyāyavidhe- rvyāpāraḥ |
evaṃ ca svādhyāyāyāmapi svādhikṛtakarmavidhi-
bhāgamātrasya arthajñānenāpi karmasiddhiḥ apratyuhā |
puruṣa- paraṃ pratyavekṣyati iti tṛtīye 'jñāte ca vācanaṃ nahya- vidvān vihito'sti ' (3|8|18 sū.) ityatra bhāṣya- vārttikayoḥ spaṣṭam |
na ca svādhyāyavidhitastacchabdā- nusāreṇa 'vedo'dhyeyaḥ ' itivedaśabdasya svādhyāyāmātra- tve'pi 'jñeyaḥ ' ityaṃśe vedaśabdasya tathā saṃkoce mānā- bhāva iti vācyam |
adhyeyaḥ iyam anvitasyaiva veda- śabdasya svādhyāyāmātraparatayā niścitasya 'jñeyaḥ ' itya- trāpi anvayavaśādeva tathā saṃkocalābhāt |
kastvavedā- rthajñānasya adhyayanavidhiprayuktatvābhāvādeva kalpasūtrapraṇa- yanamarthavat |
uktaṃ ca bhavatsvābhiprāye 'brāhmaṇānāṃ bahutvāt, ekaikasyāṃ śākhāyāṃ aparisamāptatvāt, arthasya ca durgrahītatvāt asarvajanīnatvāt, saṃdṛṣṭavivaraṇārthaṃ sūtraṃ yuddhyā karmaṇyupajñāya phalāni sarve prāpnuyuḥ iti kalpa ārabhya ācāryeṇa ' iti |
kiṃcaivaṃ 'yo ha vā aviditārṣeyacchandodaivatabrāhmaṇena mantreṇa yājayati vā'dhyāpayati vā, sthāṇuṃ varcchati gate vā patye pāpīyān bhavati, pra vā mīyate, yātāyāmyanyasya cchandāṃsi bhavanti, tasmādetāni mantremantre vidyāt ' iti tāṇḍakatalavakārādirāṣṭrāsu mantrapratipādya- devatānāṃ viniyojakabrāhmaṇānāṃ ca smaraṇavidhānaṃ kastva- vedārthajñānasya āvaśyakatve anarthakaṃ syāt |
mantreṣu deva- tāvagamastu kātyāyanādipraṇītamardhānukramaṇikādi- granthato vedārthajñānābhāve'pi sulabha eva |
viniyojaka- brāhmaṇavākyajñānaṃ ca kalpasūtrataḥ sulabhameva, nānādhāvāgata- viniyojakabrāhmaṇavākyasaṃgrahātmakatvāt kalpasūtrāṇām |
'evaṃvidemevādhvaryuṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemeva hotārṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemevadgātārṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ', 'evaṃvidemevabrahmāṇaṃ kurvīta nānevaṃvidaṃ ' ityādi vājamaneyakādiśākhāgatāni lugādānādi- brāhmaṇatadarthavidābheva adhyayaurviparaṇāni ca kastva- vedārthajñānasya anāvaśyakatāṃ gamayanti |
ata eva ca kalpasūtreṣu svādhyāyopasaṃhārasya pravṛtteṣu kastvavedārthajñāna- karmādhikāriṇopagatayā nopanibaddham |
kiṃca brahma- mīmāṃsāyāṃ tṛtīyacaturthādhikaraṇe ' śeṣatvāt puruṣārthe- vādo yathā'yeṣyite jaiminiḥ ' iti sūtreṇa (3|4| 1|2) ātmajñānaṃ karmaśeṣabhūtakartṛdvārā parvatāditavat karmāṅgaṃ, 'tarati śokamātmavit ' iti phalaśrutistu apāpaślokaśravaṇādivat arthavādaḥ iti jaiminimate pūrva- pakṣatayā udbhāvya ' taddhato vidhānāt ' (3|4|16 brasū.) iti sūtrāntareṇa 'ācāryakuladamedamadhītya ' iti śrutvā sakalavedārthajñānavataḥ karmavidhānādapi liṅgāt karmāṅgaṃ ātmavidyā iti svayaṃ yuktyantaramudrāya ' adhi- kopadeśāttat bādarāyaṇasyaiva taddarśanāt ' (3|4|18 brasū.) iti siddhāntamupasthāya ' adhyayanamātravataḥ ' iti sūtreṇa (3|4|19 brasū.) 'ācāryakuladamedamadhītya ' iti vākye vedārthajñānamātrataḥ karma vidhīyate na tada- rthajñānataḥ, yena kastvavedārthajñānavataḥ karmavidhānāt aupaniṣadamātmajñānasya karmaśeṣatā syāt |
ṛtuvidhiprayu- kāryajñānaṃ tu ārthikatvāt na karmāṅgaṃ brīhādividhau karma- ṇādivat |
evaṃ ca ṛtuvidhibhiḥ yāvadupaśrutavedabhāgamā- tārthajñānasya apekṣānāt tadviruddhaniyamajñānasya karma- śeṣatā yujyate ityāsīt bhagavatā bādarāyaṇena |
tadetat bhāṣye bhagavatpādaiḥ tadvyākhyātṛbhiśvācaspatiprabhṛtibhiḥ bahudhā prapañcitaṃ iti neha tanyate |
kiṃca ' na prathama- yaśe pravṛtyāt, pravṛttyā''dyā ' ityupakramya 'yo'nūcānaḥ śrotriyaḥ tasya pravṛtyāt ' iti āpastamba-satyāṣāḍha- bhāradvājādyudāhṛtabahvṛcabrāhmaṇe ' ekāṃ śāgvāmadhītya śrotriyo bhavati ' itilakṣitaśrotriyasya, ' sāṅgā- dhyāyī anūcānaḥ ' itilakṣitasyānasya ca prathamayaśe pravargyaniyamavidhānāt atathāvidhasya prathamayaśe pravargyā- niyamavidhau paryavasānāvāgamastvavedārthajñānasya karma- śeṣatā dūrāpāstā |
tataśca svādhyāyavidhiḥ svādhyāyā- mātrādhyayanaṃ prayojayati |
'jñeyaśca ' iti vidhirapi svādhyāyā- mātrādhyayanasya prayojakaḥ |
tadanuvartanollaṅghanayoḥ puruṣasya abhyudayapratyavāyau |
ṛtuvidhivastu yāvadupaśrutavedatadarthāva- gamamātreṇāpi kṛtārthāḥ kastvavedatadarthādhīme tāvat naiva vyāpriyante |
evaṃ ca arthavādaviṣaye svādhyāyavidhitaḥ phaladarthaparyavasānālābhāt teṣāṃ vidhyuddeśākāṅkṣānuthā-
nāt vidhyarthavādānāṃ parasparākāṅkṣatvāt ekavākyatvaṃ iti siddhānto vārttikakārāyuktaḥ anupapannaḥ |
arthavādānāṃ stutiparatayā vidhyaikavākyatā tu anya- tarākāṅkṣayaiva upapādyā |
tathāhi |
yathā ' raktaḥ paṭo bhavati ' iti vākye ' paṭo bhavati ' ityetāvati nirā- kāṅkṣe'pi 'raktaḥ ' ityasya bhaktikriyā'nvayaṃ vinā anartha- kyāpatyā saṃnidhipāṭavaiyarthyāpattyā ca paṭavākyasya raktapade ākāṅkṣotthitau paṭaviśeṣaṇasamarpakatayā raktapadaṃ paṭa- vākyāntarbhāvamāpadyate, tathā arthavādānāṃ svārthato nirā- kāṅkṣatve'pi vidhipratyayagamyāyāḥ śabdabhāvanāyāḥ aṃśa- prathamapekṣamāṇāyāḥ vidhivyatyaya eva bhāvyāṃśaṃ puruṣa- pravṛttiṃ, karaṇāṃśaṃ śaktigrahādikaṃ ca vyākaraṇādito labdha- valyāḥ, tṛtīyāṃśaṃ stutiṃ apekṣamāṇāyāḥ stutilābhamantarā anupapattyā vidhyuddeśasaṃnidhyāmanāt vaiyarthyāpattyā ca artha- vādānāṃ vidhyadeśākāṅkṣā uttiṣṭhati |
tadvācya lakṣaṇayā teṣāṃ stutiparatvaṃ iti bhāṣyānuyāyī sugamaḥ panthāḥ |
kiṃca ' aupadhe yiva śimā te vardhiṣyate ' ityādi- laukikavākyeṣviva ' sa āmanto vayāmudakivadat ' ' gāvo vā etat satramāsata ' ityādyarthavādavākyeṣvapi asadavattvāvalambanena kevalavidheṣustutiparatvaṃ, na tu svārthaparatvamapi, tathā sati aprāmāṇyaprasaṅgāt |
nahi vede mātrāmātrāsyāpi ānarthakyamiyyate |
tathā ca 'tatsā- mānyāditareṣu tathātvaṃ ' iti nyāyena (1|2|123) tadita- reṣāmapi 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā ' ityādyarthavādānāṃ na svārthapara- tvam |
kiṃtu jahatsvārthalakṣaṇayā kevalavidheyastutiparatvaṃ iti pracchannabauddhāḥ ke cit mīmāṃsakamanyāḥ |
(prābhākarāḥ ) saṃgirante |
vaidikadhiromaṇayo vārttikakṛtastu sarveṣvapi arthavādavākyeṣu avayavārthāntikameṇaiva ajahatsvārtha- lakṣaṇāyā prāptasyaparam (pratipādayanti) |
'sa ātmano vapāṃ ' ityādi sargādau parameśvara eva svamahimnā paśuṃrūpa anyadekaṃ svīkṛtya tadapoktatvena karma prāpnuyukta ityevaṃ prakāreṇa sarvatra svārthe satyatā utpreyā |
' ātmā vā idameka evāgra āsīt ' ' parāsya śaktirvividhaiva śrūyate svābhāvikī jñānabalakriyā ca ' ityādyarthavāda- vākyaiḥ acintyaśaktiparameśvarakartṛkasṛṣṭimalyaṅgī- kārāt |
' ādityo yūpaḥ ' ityādāvapi ūrdhvatvādiguṇayo- gāt svārthaparatā'pi |
tathā ca ' virodhe guṇavādaḥ syādanu- vādo'vadhārite |
bhūtārthavādastadvadānādarthavādaścidhā mataḥ ||
' iti manyante |
yuktaṃ caitat ' guṇavādastu ' ' rūpāt prāyāt ' 'dūrabhūmyatvāt ' ' rūpaprāyāt ' kartṛśca putradarśanāt ' 'ākālikepsā ' ityādibhiḥ arthavādādhikaraṇaguṇasūtraiḥ 'stainaṃ manaḥ ' ityādiṣu gauṇyā vṛttyā avayavārthaparatvasyāpi pradarśanāt |
kiṃca arthavādānāmayavārthaparatvābhāve 'vidhiṃśabdāśca ' iti mantrādhikaraṇasthaguṇasūtravirodhaḥ |
tatra ' agre gṛhapate sugṛhapateḥ ' ityādimantreṣu ' śataṃ himāḥ ' ityādyaṃśānāṃ ' śataṃ te hemantānihapiyati iti vāvaitadāha ' ityādivākyaśeṣāḥ mantrāṇāṃ vivakṣitārthatve liṅgaṃ iti vyavasthāpanāt |
kiṃca smṛtipāde yavavarāhā- dhikaraṇavirodhaḥ (1|3|418-vā. pṛ. 288-290) |

prakṛtau vā dviruktatvāt |
bhāṣyaṃ - 'prakṛtau vā niveśiren anāramyādhītāni pātrāṇi |
kutaḥ ? adiruktatvāt, evaṃ adiruktaṃ bhavi- ṣyatīti |
dviruktatāyāṃ ko doṣaḥ ? asaṃbhava iti brūmaḥ |
yadi prakṛtau vikṛtau ca bhavati asi tat prakṛtau |
prakṛtau cedasti, codakenaiva vikṛtiṃ prāpnoti |
tato na anāramyavidhimākāṅkṣati |
tasmāt anākāṅkṣitatvāt anāramyavidhiḥ na tatra vidyate |
tena brūmaḥ prakṛtyaiḥ eveti |
vā - sarvavidhīnāṃ aprāptakaviṣayatvāt yatra pramā- ṇāntareṇa prāsirnāsti, tatra khādiratvādyupadeśaḥ |
prakṛtau ca na kutaścit prāptiḥ |
vikṛtiṣu aṅkāntarārthe avaśyakalpanīyena atideśena khādiratvādi prāpnoti, iti nopadeśamapekṣate |
tena dviruktasya asaṃbhava ityāha |
tava dviruktatvāt, adiruktatvādvā mama iti sūtram |
tadjaṃ tu vacanaprāpte |
bhāṣyaṃ - apakaraṇāt prakṛtivikṛtyarthameva ityucyate |

tasmāt anāramyavidhirvā codakaḥ prāpayiṣyati |
anāramyavidhivākyena pratyakṣeṇa khuve khādiratā, codakavākyena ānumānikena vikṛtau |
ānumānikāt pratyakṣaṃ balavat |
tasmāt prakṛtivikṛtyathaiḥ anāramyavidhiḥ |
vā - (tadjaṃ tu vacanaprāpte) prāpteḥ iti vā pāṭhaḥ |
satyaṃ dviruktamanvayārthaṃ, tatra kuta etat, atideśaprāp- tvāt upadeśo vihanyate, na punaḥ upadeśāsiddhaṃ atideśa eva prāpayediti ? yuktaṃ ca padārtheviprakarṣāt atideśo na syāt, saṃnikarṣāt pūrvatarapravṛttopadeśāśrayaṇam |
athocyeta sāmānyaviṣayatvāt upadeśo durbala iti, tat atideśe'pi sarvāṅgaviṣayatvāt aviśeṣam |
tasmāt sarvārthaḥ anāramyavidhi iti |
darśanāditi cet |

kutaḥ ? śaknoti hi prakṛtivikṛtisādhāraṇaṃ khādiratvaṃ prākṛtopakārasādhane dṛṣṭa- śaktitvāt vikṛtiṃ nirākāṅkṣīkartum |

na ca anāramyavidhiḥ khuvaṃ prāpayati, tasya ca khādiratām |
kutaḥ ? codanākāthyāt |
ekārthā hi codanā 'yasya khādiraḥ khuvo bhavati' iti |

tasmāt asti codakaḥ |
sa hi anāramyavidhivākyasya taṃ varjayitvā taṃ varjayitvā anyaṃ prāpayati |

adhyāhāranyāyaḥ |
adhyā- hārānuṣaṅganyāyaḥ ||
anuṣaṅgo vākyasamāptiḥ; sarveṣu tulyayogi- tvāt |
bhāṣyaṃ - 'yā te agne'yāśayā tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā gahva- reṣṭhaṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ tveṣaṃ vaco apāvadhīṃ svāhā, yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā ' iti |
atra saṃdehaḥ tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā iti sarveṣu anuṣaktavyaṃ, āhosvit laukiko vākyaśeṣaḥ kartavya iti |
kiṃ prāptaṃ ? 'yā te agne rajāśayā ' ityetasya tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā iti na vākyaśeṣaḥ |
nahi ayaṃ asmāt paraḥ prayujyate |
evaṃ prāpte brūmaḥ |
anuṣaṅgo vākyasamāptiḥ syāt tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā iti |
yathaiva hi ayaṃ 'yā te agne'yāśayā ' ityetasā- nantaraṃ, evaṃ 'yā te agne rajāśayā, yā te agne harāśayā ' ityetorapi |
harāśayā ityetasya vyavahita iti cet, tantra, samudāyasya avyavadhānāt |
avyavahito rajāśayā iti samudāyaḥ |
samudāyena ca vākyaśeṣasya saṃbandhā- bhāvāt samudāyārthasya saṃbandhaḥ |
samudāyārthena ca na gamyate viśeṣaḥ |
tasmāt sarvatrānuṣaṅgaḥ |
api ca sākāṅkṣasya saṃnidhau parastāt purastāt paripūrṇasamarthaḥ śrūyamāṇo vākyaśeṣo bhavati |
kiṃyāstu kālaḥ saṃnidhiḥ iti ucyate ? yāvati śaknoti ubhau api apekṣitum |
kaśśasau ? ānantarye saṃbandhapadavyavāyo vā ! tāvati hi śaknoti ubhavāpi apekṣitum |
saṃbandhapadavyavāye hi saṃbandhādeva pūrvasaṃskāro nāpaiti |
yatrāpi apareṇa sākā- ṅkṣatvena vyavāyaḥ, tatrāpi asti saṃbandhaḥ |
dvayorapi hi kāryaṃ vaktavyaṃ iti paraḥ pūrvamapekṣate |
anapekṣamāṇe anyataraḥ pramādapāṭhaḥ syāt |
śakyate cāsau apekṣitu- m |
tasmāt yathaiva ekasya saṃnidhau, evamaparasya |
dvayorapi asaṃbaddhaiḥ padaiḥ avyavahitatvāt, dvayorapi ākāṅkṣāvattvāt |
etāvacca vākyaśeṣasaṃbandhe kāraṇaṃ,
nānantaryam |
avyavadhāne vicchede'pi bhavati saṃbandhaḥ |
tasmādanuṣaṅgaḥ |
athaivaṃ bhavitavyaṃ, yatra nirākāṅkṣāṇāṃ saṃnidhau paripūrṇasamarthaḥ śrūyate, yathā 'citpatistvā punātu, vākpa- tistvā punātu, devastvā savitā punātu acchidraṇa pavi- treṇa vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ ' iti |
atra hi punāla- ntāni paripūrṇāni, na kiṃcidākāṅkṣanti |
nanu acchi- dreṇa ityetādākāṅkṣati |
satyamākāṅkṣati, ākāṅkṣadapi etat ekamākāṅkṣat, ekenaiva tat nirākāṅkṣa saṃpadyate iti |
ekena hi nirākāṅkṣīkṛto netaro ākāṅkṣiṣyati |
anarthakatvādākāṅkṣati, ekena ca saṃvaddho nārthako bhavati |
tasmāt netaro ākāṅkṣati |
itarāpi paripūrṇa- tvāt na tamākāṅkṣataḥ |
nanu etasya vākyaśeṣasya eka- mapi ākāṅkṣataṃ na gamyate viśeṣaḥ; kena nirākāṅkṣī- kriyate kena vā neti, tena anavagamyamāne viśeṣe sarvaiḥ saha saṃbhansyate |
āha, naitadevam |
yena asya pratyakṣamāntaravyupalabhyabhāhe, tena saha saṃbhansyate iti gamyate viśeṣaḥ; tasmāt tena antareṇa saha saṃbhansyate iti nāsti sarvatrānuṣaṅga iti |
āha, naitadevam |
punātu- śabdena asya pratyakṣamāntaryaṃ upalabhyabhāhe, punātu- śabdasyāpi citpatistvā ityevamādibhiḥ |
ekaśvāsau punātu-śabdaḥ punaḥ punaracaritaḥ |
tenāvacchinnāmo yatra punātu-śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ, tatra tena ekavākyatvāt acchi- dreṇa ityevamādi vinā punātu-śabdena sākāṅkṣāḥ |
te ca punātu-śabda ākāṅkṣanti, sa ca punātu- śabdaḥ acchidreṇa ityanena viśiṣṭaḥ |
tena punātu- śabdena sānuṣaṅgeṇa niyogataḥ sarve nirākāṅkṣīkartavyāḥ |
tasmāt sarveṣu tulyayogaḥ iti vākyaparisamāpti- ranuṣajyate |
vā--jyotiṣṭome tisṛṇāmapi upasadāṃ ādau āgneyī vihitā 'amimīnakaṃ ' iti |
tatra prathamāyāḥ krame 'yā te agne'yāśayā ' iti nirākāṅkṣo mantra āmnāyate |
uttarayostu sākāṅkṣau 'yā te agne rajāśayā ' 'yā te agne harāśayā ' iti |
tatra strīliṅgavyucchidanardeśasya śrīpadāyaina kena ciddinā paripūrṇatā nāsti |
na ca aparipūrṇena vyavahāro'vakalpate |

kutaḥ ? 'nyūnavākyaprayogo hi vede naiva samāśritaḥ |
kaścit kāpi sthitaḥ śeṣaḥ so'nveṣṭavyaḥ prayatnataḥ ||
' nahi vaidikavākyānāṃ pratyakṣameva ekaṃ pramāṇam |
tadveva hi anumānādīnyapi pramāṇāni |
sarvapramāṇapralastamaye ca padyena abhāvaḥ paricchidyate |
tadiha pratyakṣopalabhye vākyaśeṣe na tāvatyeva uparatanvyam |
yadi anumānādīnyapi nivarti- ṣyante, tata etāvānevāyaṃ mantraḥ iti kalpayiṣyāmaḥ |
atha tu taiḥ kaścidavagamyate, tataḥ tatsahito'yaṃ mantraḥ sakalaḥ, prāk tasādūnaḥ, ityadhyavasyāmaḥ |
tadiha arthā- patyā tāvat sāmānyataḥ kaścit asti śeṣaḥ ityadhya- vaseyam |
tataśca amāvasyānya anavasarāt, ūnamidaṃ vākyaṃ na prayogāhe, tatra viśeṣākāṅkṣāyāṃ laukikaḥ kalpanīyaḥ; uta vaidika eva pūrvamantrataḥ tanūrvarṣiṣṭhā ityādiranuṣaṅgyaḥ; iti saṃśaye laukika ityāha |
tathāhi, ' nānyatrotsahate gantuṃ vaidikaṃ saṃnibandhanam |
yatheṣṭaviniyogo tu sarvārthaṃ vastu laukikam ||
' yathaiva āhavanīyādayo vaidikāḥ tannirdiṣṭakāryātirekeṇa na pravartante, tathaiva vaidikaḥ śeṣaḥ, yatra vākye samāmnā- yena viniyuktaḥ, sa tannibandhanatvāt nānyatra prayogaṃ kṣamate |
laukikaḥ punaḥ anivaddhatvāt sarvārthaḥ; sarvā- kāṅkṣāpūraṇāyāpi niyajyamāno na virudhyate |
tasmāt laukikaḥ |
tatra yadi vaidikamapi racitatvāt laghutara- prayogaṃ racayiṣyatvāt avaidikāt laukikāt manvānaḥ prayuṅkte, na kena cit vāryate, vaidikatvabuddhistu tatra na kartavyā |
tathāhi, 'tāneva vaidikān varṇān bhāratādiniveśitān |

' ekasminnarthe sākāṅkṣatve abhihite prakṛtyā pratyayena vā, tatsaṃbandhasamarthe arthāntaraṃ yadi vā tatraiva dṛśyate tato ramaṇīyam |

loke'pi cennopalabhyeta tato nāstītyevamavadhārya ākāṅkṣābuddhiṃ antikatvena parikalpya nirākāṅkṣīkartavyam |

' tadiha rajāyā- harāśayāvākyayoḥ śeṣaḥ svapadasvavākyayoḥ alabhyamāna- tvāt vākyāntare nūnaṃ ityupasaṃhiyate |

iti |

śuddhakratudharmapratiṣedhe tu 'yāva- kratau kiṃ vidadyataṃ (tatra) yajamānasya ṛtvijāṃ vā anutataṃ prajñayate tat sarvaṃ na kartavyaṃ' (ityarthaḥ :) ṛtu- saṃgrahatvāviśeṣāt |

adapi ca punaḥ saṃskārārthe kiṃ cit, tadapi kratvartho'nena varjayitavyam |
nanu ca pratiṣedhārthe guṇabhūtaḥ puruṣaḥ, tata ādhyarthavasamāsayā niyāmakaḥ, iti praṇītāpraṇayanādadhvaryuḥ anutapratiṣedhamatha- lambheta, satyamatvamatveta, yadi pratiṣedhārthaḥ anujñeyo bhavet |
ayaṃ tu anujñānābhāvātmakatvāt na kartṛviśeṣa- mapekṣate |
śrutyaiva (niṣedhyapadasāhacaryalakṣaṇayā) ca pratiṣedhaḥ prāpyā (niṣedhyaprāptyā) saṃvadaḥ |
sa (niṣedhaḥ) yatra prātaḥ, tatra svātmanyeva gacchan na śakyate samākhyāyā vārayitum |
nanu 'vadet' itye- tāvat vidhyaṃśamātramalevyamānaṃ samākhyā niyaṃvasati, tataśca pratiṣedho'pi tadanusāritvāt niyato bhaviṣyati, naitadevam |
paryavasite hi śāstrārthe tarkatarpekṣāyāṃ satyāṃ samākhyā avatarati |

pratiṣedhasaṃvanatvāt hi tat anu- vādatvena sthitam |

kimuta samākhyāyā vidhīyamānapadārthakartṛviśeṣavanmātre eva vyāpyate |

ihodāharaṇam |
darśa- pūrṇamāsayoḥ 'nānutaṃ vadet' iti śrūyate |
tatra saṃśayaḥ kimayaṃ puruṣadharmaḥ: vidhiḥ, uta ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: anuvādaḥ, kiṃvā ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: vidhi, uta śuddha- kratudharmaḥ: anuvādaḥ, athavā śuddhakratudharmaḥ: vidhiḥ iti (soma—kimayaṃ vidhiḥ, uta anuvādaḥ |
vidhi- pakṣe kiṃ śuddhapuruṣadharmaḥ: kiṃvā ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ |
tathā anuvādapakṣe'pi kiṃ ṛtuyukta- puruṣadharmaḥ: uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ: iti saṃśayaniṣkarṣaḥ ) tadarthe ca pratiṣidhyamānā kriyā vicāritavyā kimarthā satī pratiṣidhyate, kiṃ kratvarthā kiṃvā purupārthā iti |
tato'pi punarvicāritavyaṃ kimākhyātaṃ kartārama- bhidhatte, na veti |

' vadet ityākhyātāt kartuḥ pratīteḥ |
'kartīra kṛta, ' 'laḥ karmaṇi ca' iti smaraṇāt |
pacati devadattaḥ ityādikartṛviśeṣavattvaṃ: devadattādipadaiḥ apṛthak śruteḥ sahaprayogāt sāmānādhi- karaṇyāt |
tadarthamayaḥ, yat puruṣopakāritā pratyakṣata vadan tatra tathā, kiṃtu apakāramevāsa sādhyati |

yastu smārtaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, tasyāpyetadeva mūlaṃ ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
śruti-
prakaraṇayoravirodhāt ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmo'yaṃ, 'karma kurvā- ṇasya anutaṃ varjayitavyaṃ' iti |
so'yaṃ smṛtiprāptānu- vādaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
kratvartha eva ārādupakārakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ, so'pi tu anuvāda eva iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ |
atrābhidhīyate 'kratvarthatve- 'pi yat tāvadanuvādatvamīritam |
tatra saṃyoga- bhedena vidhivadeva hi gamyate ||
' idānīṃ kratuyuktasya puruṣasya vā dharmaḥ, uta śuddhakratudharmaḥ: ityetādavaśi- ṣyate |
atrocyate 'ākhyātapratyayāḥ sarve kriyāyā abhidhāyakāḥ |
tata eva pratīyasa na kartṛrbhidhe- yatā ||
na smṛtiḥ kartṛvācitve saṃkhyāvācitva- gocarā |
sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca lakṣaṇāto gavādiva- ttathā ca śrutivirodhābhāvāt kratvarthaḥ: evāyaṃ pratiṣedhaḥ |
sa ca saṃyogāntaratvāt nātuvādaḥ : (kratvarthaḥ: saṃyogaḥ ekaḥ, puruṣārthasya saṃyogaḥ bhinnaḥ ) iti |
soma-- pūrvoktānuvādāpavādāt saṃgatiḥ |
sūtrā- rthastu-- kratuprakaraṇārthaṃ akarma anutavadanācaraṇaṃ nityānuvādaḥ syāt, tasya smṛtyā upanayanaprabhṛti puruṣa- saṃyogāt iti |
vi-- 'anṛtaṃ na vadet vaidhaḥ: puṃdharmo vā'nuvāda- gīḥ |
saktau puṃsi śuddhe vā kratau yadā vidhiḥ kratau ||
, anutatveḥ: puruṣārthatvāt tanṣedhastathāvidhaḥ |
sākṣātnuvādaḥ: puṃstvataḥ: śrutiprakriyayorvasāt ||
nākhyāte puruṣānuktiḥ ṛtāveva prajāyate |
saktokiniyādamanyaḥ: saṃyogo'taḥ kratau vidhiḥ ||
' vaidhaḥ: vihitaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ puṃdharmaḥ: puruṣārthaḥ: ityekaḥ pakṣaḥ |
saktau puṃsi ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmaḥ: pratiṣedhaḥ vākyaṃ tu anuvādagīḥ: iti dvitīyaḥ |
śuddhe kratau śuddha- kratudharmaḥ: vākyaṃ tu anuvādaḥ: iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ siddhāntaḥ |
bhāṭṭa-- tattatkratuprakaraṇasthāḥ vidhinatiṣedhaviśeṣāḥ 'samidho yajati', 'nānutaṃ vadet' ityādayaḥ kiṃ śuddhapuruṣadharmāḥ, uta ṛtuyuktapuruṣadharmāḥ, uta śuddha- kratudharmāḥ: iti vicāraḥ |
yadyapi ca pratiṣedhasya parodeśapravṛttakartṛkārakatvena vidheyatvarūpaṃ aṅgatvameva durlabham |
pratiṣedhapadārthasya nivartanāyāḥ vadanānu- kūlakṛtyabhāvasya vā saṃbandhantareṇa kṛtyanvayitve'pi nimi- ttāditavat kṛtikārakalatvābhāvāt, upakārakatvavyāpyasya aṅgatvasya vyāpakābhāve asaṃbhāvyam |
pratiṣedhavadanādestu ṛtuyuktapuruṣaprabhāve avihitatvādeva kuppādivat dūrā- pāste |
ataḥ aṅgatvasaṃbhavādeva taddeśeṣuvicārāsaṃbhavaḥ, tathāpi pratiṣedhasya puruṣārthatvaṃ nāma puruṣaniṣṭhaprayatnāya- janakakriyāviṣayatvam |

abhāvapramāṇanirāsaḥ (anupalabdhirāsaḥ) |
idānīmabhāvasya pramāṇaṃ nirākriyate |
'nāsti' iti vyāhāravyavahārau pramāṇāntaramantareṇa nopapadyate iti cenna, bhūtalādiviśeṣādepavopapatteḥ |
nanu ca nāstitvavyavahārasya astitvavyavahāraviṣayabhūtaṃ bhūtalaṃ nālambanaṃ, astināsti- vyavahārayorviṣayatāprasaṅgāt |
naivaṃ, abhāvārthaṃ prameyama- stīti vādinā'pi tadabhāvasya astitvavyavahāraviṣayatva- maṅgīkṛtaṃ, itarathā abhāvābhāvasya nāstitvaprasaṅgāt |
tata- ścābhāvo'pi nāstitvavyavahāre viṣayo na syāt |
atha yadyapyabhāvasya sāpekṣayā astitvavyavahāraviṣayatvaṃ, tathāpi ghaṭāpekṣayā nāstitvavyavahāraviṣaya iti |
evaṃ tarhi bhūtalaṃ- mapi sāpekṣayā astitvavyavahāraviṣayaḥ, ghaṭāpekṣayā nāsti- vyavahāraviṣayaḥ iti kiṃ tattvāntaramabhyupagamyate ? bhūtalaṃ- mātasya viṣayatvāt |
nanu tarhi kevalo'rthaḥ ? |
yadi bhūtalameva, tarhi ghaṭavatyapi prasaṅgaḥ |

atha smaryamāṇe'pi pratiyogini bhūtalema ālambanaṃ, gṛhyamāṇe tu smaraṇābhāvādeva na nāstitvavyavahāraḥ, evaṃ tarhi deśāntaresthe gṛhyamāṇe, deśāntare tadabhāvavyavahāro na syāt |
atha tatrāpi deśāntarasaṃbandharūpasya pratiyogi- gitvāt tatsaṃbandhitayā smaraṇāsaṃbhavāt nāstitvavyavahāro syāt |
atha jijñāsite pratiyogini bhūtalamalambanaṃ,

jijñāsāyāśca vilakṣaṇavyavahārahetutvaṃ vilakṣaṇajñānahetutayā dṛṣṭaṃ, ato ghaṭajijñāsāyāṃ nāstitvavyavahārahetutvaṃ bhūtalāti- riktaghaṭābhāvaparicchedenaiva bhavatītyaṅgīkṛtaṃ tattvāntaram |
atha tadatiriktasāmagrīviśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalālambanaṃ, saṅghaṭe tu tadabhāvācca pratyakṣa iti |
kimidaṃ tadatiriktatvam ? yadi tato'nyatvaṃ, tarhi saṃsṛṣṭavyavasāyāmāpi tatsaṃbhavāt nāsti- vyavahāraprasaṅgaḥ |
yadi tadabhāvaḥ, svīkṛtameva tarhi tattvāntaram |
ato'pi etat bhūtalāmātravijñānaṃ na kāraṇaṃ, api tu bhūtalabuddhiviśeṣaḥ |
sa ca saṃsṛṣṭa- buddhivilakṣaṇa eva |
na cāpyabhāvajñānaṃ, amāvāvadimā- rabhāvajñānakāraṇatvena vilakṣaṇabuddhereṅgīkārāt, ato yasyābhāvajñānotādakalyamaṅgīkṛtaṃ, tenaiva vyavahāro'stīti |
naivaṃ, abhāvajñānādapakṣasya śaṃsasya na bhūtalātirikta- viṣayatvaṃ, bhūtalāmātraviṣayatve'pi na saṃsṛṣṭavyāmābhāva- jñānakatvaṃ, sahakārivaikalyāt |
ghaṭānupalabdhistu saha- kāriṇī, tena anupalabdhiviśiṣṭaṃ bhūtalāmātrajñānabhāva- jñotādakam |
evaṃ tarhi tadeva vyavahārakāraṇamastīti cet, naivaṃ, viṣayavailakṣaṇyābhāvāt |
tathāhi, bhūtalā- mātratve'pyupalambhasahakārisamavadhānatvāt jñānāntarotpāda- katvamupapadyate, yathaikasya ghaṭasya cakṣuḥsparśanemadāt jñānabhedaḥ |
ataḥ saṃsṛṣṭadvilakṣaṇabuddhyutpādāt abhāvajñānahetutvamupapadyate |

ataḥ abhāvajñānakāraṇenaivā- bhāvavyavahāraḥ iti na prativandisiddhiḥ |

oṃ abhyāsaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ prāthamyāt sthāna- dharmaḥ syāt|
darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ sāmidhenīḥ prakṛtya 'triḥ prathamā-manvāha triruttamāṃ' iti śrūyate|
tatra kiṃ trirvacanaṃ ṛgdharmaḥ, 'pra vo vājā' iti ṛk yatra vartamānā'pi trirvyasitavyetyetā iti, kiṃvā sthānadharmaḥ yā anyā'pi prathamamucyate sā trirvacanyā iti vicāre siddhāntamāha|
sāmidhenīnāṃ prathamāyāḥ yo'yamabhyāsa uktaḥ, sa sthāna-dharmaḥ sthānasya dharmaḥ syāt|
prathamasthāne yā ṛk ucyate, sā trirvaktavyā iti|
prāthamyāt 'triḥ prathamānvāha' iti abhyasanīyatvā ṛcaḥ prāthamyoktvāt|
tasmā-nyāyaṃ ṛco dharmaḥ, kiṃtu prathamasya sthānasyeti|
tena yatra ekaiva sāmidhenī syāt, sā'pi pravovājīyāyāḥ bhinnā, sā'pi trirvaktavyā|
ke. oṃ abhyāsaḥ sāmidhenīnāṃ prāthamyāt sthānadharmaḥ syāt|

‘guṇopasrjanadravyapratipādanayogyānāṃ paricchedamukhena kriyā'nvayināṃ paricchedadravyaliṅga- saṃbandhaḥ’ iti hi tadarthaḥ |
bhavati ca ‘aruṇākṣaḥ’ ityādau aruṇaśabdaḥ avaśayaṃ tadguṇadravyavacanaḥ, iti tasyaiva kevalaguṇavacanatve'pi paricchedakahāyanyādvārā liṅganvayaḥ |

ityādiprayogasyāprasaktiḥ |

tat siddhaṃ aruṇāśabdasya strīpratyayāntasyāpi kevalaguṇa- vacanatvam |

ityavacchadyatayā dravyasya pratīti- viśeṣo hi paricchedaḥ |

vākyabhede tu ‘aruṇā’ iti tṛtīyā lākṣaṇikamakṛtyarthadravyagata- karaṇatvānuvādinī syāt |

paricchedakatvāpekṣayā ekahāyanyāḥ ekavākyatvena guṇena, paricchedyāpekṣaśca ca guṇasya svavākyatvayā ekahāyanyā ākāṅkṣāśāntisaṃbhave guṇāntareṇa dravyāntareṇa ca tacchā- ntivarṇanasyāvaśyakatvāt |
